jobs.description:
Cargill’s size and scale allows us to make a positive impact in the world. Our purpose is to nourish the world in a safe, responsible and sustainable way.

 

Cargill is a family company providing food, ingredients, agricultural solutions and industrial products that are vital for living. We connect farmers with markets so they can prosper. We connect customers with ingredients so they can make meals people love. And we connect families with daily essentials — from eggs to edible oils, salt to skincare, feed to alternative fuel. Our 160,000 colleagues, operating in 70 countries, make essential products that touch billions of lives each day. Join us and reach your higher purpose at Cargill.

 

This position is in Cargill’s protein and salt business, where we provide wholesome, high\-quality food products to a wide range of customers, from foodservice operators and grocery stores to manufacturers and exporters. Job Purpose and Impact

 

 

 

The Administrative Assistant II will provide moderately complex, varied to routine administrative and clerical support. In this role, you will coordinate, integrate and implement assigned administrative or staff functions. Key Accountabilities

 

 

 

Apply knowledge of department operations and infrastructure, policies and procedures to perform moderately complex administrative processes.

 

Solicit, collect and organize documentation and data, performing moderately complex data entry into one or more systems.

 

Receive and relay messages and respond to varied and routine administrative requests.

 

Handle moderately complex clerical, administrative, technical or customer support issues under general supervision, while escalating more complex issues to appropriate staff.

 

Other duties as assigned

 

 

 

\#LI\-AB3 Qualifications

 

Minimum Qualifications

 

 

 

High school diploma, secondary education level or equivalent

 

Minimum requirement of 2 years of relevant work experience

 

MS office experience

 

Preferred Qualifications

 

 

 

Mandarin or Spanish as a second language

 

SAP experience

 

Salesforce experience

 

 

 

Equal Opportunity Employer, including Disability/Vet

jobs.title: Veterinary Assistant
jobs.description:
**Description**

 

 

 

 

 

Lien Animal Clinic is looking for a Full\-Time Veterinary Assistant to join our team!

 

 

 

Compensation negotiable based on credentials and experience with a hourly pay rate starting at $20\.76 \- $23 / hour. The actual rate offered will carefully consider a wide range of factors, including your skills, qualifications and experience.

 

 

 

**Why Join Our Team?**

 

At Lien Animal Clinic, we’re a well\-established, fast\-paced small\-animal practice located in the heart of West Seattle, proudly serving our community since 1951\. Our team includes four dedicated doctors and over 20 talented support staff who genuinely care about each other, our clients, and every patient that comes through our doors.

 

 

 

We’re committed to delivering exceptional veterinary care and creating a warm, welcoming experience for our clients—many of whom have been with us for generations. Our workplace is collaborative, supportive, and filled with opportunities to learn and grow. We value positivity, teamwork, and a healthy dose of humor to get us through the busy days.

 

 

 

If you're someone who brings enthusiasm, compassion, and a strong work ethic, and you thrive in a dynamic environment, we’d love to meet you. This is a place where you can truly make a difference—and have fun doing it.

 

 

 

**Job description:**

 

 

 

The Veterinary Assistant is a position that works closely with the Veterinarians, Technicians \& Client Service Representatives. This role includes administrative and personnel duties. The role of the Veterinary Assistant can be challenging and requires excellent interpersonal skills dealing with clients and patients. He or she must be able to work with a team, pay attention to detail, and respond quickly and calmly to crises.

 

 

 

This position requires good computer skills, strong math skills and the ability to make change. At a minimum, a high school diploma or equivalent is required. You must pass a pre\-employment background check and drug screening. The position requires an employee capable of lifting 50 pounds unaided and be able to stand or walk for a majority of the day. You must have the ability to learn how to pronounce, the meaning of and spell commonly used veterinary terms. The employee must be able to qualify for a Washington State Medication Clerk License within 90 days of employment.

 

 

 

**Qualifications:*** Strong Client service skills, friendly, professional and courteous.

* Strong Organizational Skills

* Good interpersonal communication skills.

* Excellent verbal and written skills are mandatory.

* Ability to multi\-task with continuous interruptions and focus on accurate data entry.

* Ability to work cooperatively in a team environment

* Work with a multi\-line phone system

* Experience with Microsoft Office Suite is desired.

* Prior experience working in a veterinary clinic or other medical clinic is a plus.

 

 

 

We invest heavily in our employees' long\-term growth and happiness. We offer wonderful benefit packages including medical, vision and dental insurance, plus a 100% paid life insurance policy for you too! PTO, internal and external continuing education, bonuses, dynamic pet care discounts, 401K, and much, much, more!

 

 

 

**If you want to make a positive impact on our clients and patients lives, then we want you on our team. Apply Today!**

jobs.title: Exhibiting Assistant
jobs.description:
Exhibiting Assistant

 

**Department:** Operations – Events

 

**Supervisor:** Manager, Exhibiting

 

**Status:** Non\-Exempt, Full\-Time **(Temporary – 3 months)**

 

**Location:** Remote

 

**Supervisory Responsibilities:** None

 

**Travel:** 0\-1x/year

 

**Rate of Pay:** $24\.20\-28\.28/hour

 

**EEO Category:** Administrative Support Workers

 

**Position Summary:** The Exhibiting Assistant is expected to provide support to the Manager, Exhibiting, with exhibitor administrative, communications, and logistics tasks. The Exhibiting Assistant will be expected to keep the exhibition duties organized and streamlined in addition to providing superior customer service to exhibitors.

 

**Primary Responsibilities:**

 

**Exhibit \& Sponsorship Coordination: Annual International Conference (AIC)**

 

* Support the logistics of the AIC exhibit process, including managing incoming ExpoGenie applications, updating floorplans, and providing administrative assistance with the Asana vetting process.

* Schedule and coordinate meetings with prospective sponsors and exhibitors.

 

**Exhibit \& Sponsorship Coordination: Online Cohort\-Based Programs**

 

* Follow up on outreach emails and manage sponsor collateral submissions for digital sponsorship directories.

* Coordinate the creation and execution of landing pages for sponsorship directories.

* Assist with attendee list delivery and post\-event communications to sponsors.

 

**Logistics \& Administrative Support**

 

* Serve as the primary contact for the exhibitor inbox, tracking and responding to all inquiries with a high level of customer service.

* Develop and disseminate communications and forms to exhibitors and sponsors, clearly outlining deadlines and deliverables.

* Support timeline management by following up with exhibitors and sponsors and relaying their needs to relevant internal and external stakeholders.

* Maintain accurate and up\-to\-date CRM (HubSpot) records for all exhibitors and sponsors.

* Collaborate with the accounting team to support timely and accurate invoicing and payment collection.

* Perform a variety of administrative tasks, including data entry, research, taking meeting minutes, and document creation.

* Act as a general support resource for exhibit\-related administrative needs, escalating more complex matters as appropriate.

* Demonstrate flexibility in adapting to evolving project and program needs and consistently uphold IFM’s policies and values in all interactions.

* This role may perform additional duties not listed above but essential to supporting the success of the Exhibiting Assistant function.

 

**What We’re Looking For:**

 

* Experience in an administrative role preferred.

* Experience supporting events preferred.

* Attention to Detail: Ability to be detail oriented \- to apply thorough attention to work in order to ensure all details are accurate.

* Accountability \& Execution: Ability to work independently and meet deadlines; ability to plan, prioritize, and focus on critical issues and see work through completion.

* Communication: Ability to communicate information in concise, actionable language and have the recipient understand the message whether orally or in writing.

* Teamwork: Ability to collaborate with teams on communication processes, goals, schedules, and outcomes. Demonstrated ability to build and maintain positive relationships and actively contributes as a member of working teams to achieve results. Embodies the employee values to build, motivate and maintain healthy and functional teams.

* Technical: Willingness to learn MS Office Suite; Ability to adapt to and learn new technologies, hardware, and software; Familiarity with event management software, virtual platforms, and other technology tools used for exhibitor communication, registration, and engagement.

 

**Our Advice**

 

*At IFM we consider all applicants with a wide range of experiences and backgrounds that are relevant and applicable to the role. If you don’t see yourself fully reflected in all of the qualifications listed, we welcome you to inquire still. Our highly collaborative culture is grounded in a commitment to ensure respectful and positive working relationships where every team member has a sense of belonging.*

 

**Get to Know Us**

 

The team at IFM is changing the way medicine is practiced and transforming the health (and lives) of millions of people around the world. Every single day, our teammates impact the quality of patient care through their unique roles that support the mission of our organization!

 

Although we are a remote workforce, we believe in the importance of personal connections to build positive and collaborative working relationships. These connections are fostered through virtual team events, intentional development opportunities, and thoughtful benefits geared to support employees in their home offices. You can find members of IFM’s team in 26 states across the US!

 

Interested? Our team is hungry and inspired and we want you to be too. Strive to grow with us!

 

**Interview Process**

 

1\. You see this job posting, it piques your interest, and you apply!

 

2\. A member of our HR team reaches out to you to schedule an introductory phone screen.

 

3\. The hiring manager selects candidates (and possibly you!) to move forward with a virtual video interview and meet with members of the team.

 

4\. Our team is highly collaborative, and we want to ensure that you have a chance to interact with and meet our amazing team. So, bear with us, our interview process is subject to our team’s availability but rest assured, we are actively working to schedule your interview(s).

 

5\. We look forward to meeting you!

 

If you have any questions about your candidacy, please direct all questions to a member of the Human Resources Department so we can best respond to your inquiry!

 

**Interviewing Remotely**

 

During the recruitment process, candidates must ensure that they are interviewing from a location that has the necessary connectivity to the internet to facilitate effective interview participation.

 

To ensure that you have a positive experience attending your interview, please verify that your internet connectivity **provides a minimum of** **5 Megabits per second (Mbps) in upload speed.** Please be mindful that should you have multiple devices accessing your network, it is recommended that your wireless speed accommodates the usage needs of these devices.

 

Contact your Internet Service Provider (ISP) to request the connectivity information directly. If your ISP is not able to provide you with that information, visit **www.speedtest.net**to perform a speed test on your device.

 

**Wireless Technology Minimums**

 

Your wireless router must be able to broadcast at the same speed as your upload speed, if not higher.

 

Wireless routers can broadcast at over 1 Gigabit per second (Gbps), and many companies don't upgrade your router when you upgrade service. This often means that your wireless speeds are significantly lower than the upload speed that is available to you.

 

*Should you receive an offer of employment, internet connectivity minimums as described above remain the same for the duration of the employment relationship.*

 

**Equal Employment Opportunity**

 

The Institute for Functional Medicine, IFM, is a federal government contractor and an Equal Opportunity Employer. IFM invites all applicants to apply regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, and/or veteran status. As such, IFM invites you to voluntarily self\-identify as a qualified individual, if applicable using the Voluntary EEO Form.

 

If you need accommodations during the interview process, please inform the Human Resources representative as soon as possible. IFM will make every effort to provide a reasonable accommodation(s) during the interview and hiring process.

 

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, or national origin. Completion of this information is voluntary and as such, adverse action will not be taken should you decide to not self\-identify. The information you submit will be kept confidential.

 

**Applicants Rights under Federal Employment Laws**

 

**FMLA:** https://www.dol.gov/sites/dolgov/files/WHD/legacy/files/fmlaen.pdf

 

**EEO:** https://www.dol.gov/ofccp/regs/compliance/posters/pdf/eeopost.pdf

 

**EPPA**: https://www.dol.gov/sites/dolgov/files/WHD/legacy/files/eppac.pdf

 

Job Type: Full\-time

 

Pay: $24\.20 \- $28\.28 per hour

 

Benefits:

 

* 401(k)

* 401(k) matching

* Dental insurance

* Flexible schedule

* Health insurance

* Life insurance

* Paid time off

* Vision insurance

 

Schedule:

 

* Day shift

 

Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Front Desk Administrative Assistant
jobs.description:
**Job Overview**

 

We are seeking a highly polished and professional Front Desk Administrative Assistant to serve as the first point of contact for our organization. This role is pivotal in creating a welcoming and efficient environment for clients, visitors, and staff, delivering exceptional customer service while managing a wide range of administrative responsibilities.

 

**Key Responsibilities**

 

**Guest and Client Services:** Act as the face of the company, warmly greeting visitors, answering inquiries, providing directions, and notifying staff of arriving clients.

 

**Phone System Management:** Efficiently handle a multi\-line phone system by directing calls to appropriate extensions, taking accurate messages, and facilitating conference call setups as needed.

 

**Mail and Delivery Coordination:** Receive, sort, and distribute incoming mail and deliveries to the correct recipients promptly; manage outgoing mail and packages for pickup.

 

**Reception Area Upkeep:** Maintain a clean, organized, and professional reception area, ensuring a clutter\-free and welcoming environment.

 

**Office Maintenance:** Oversee basic building maintenance, including coordinating cleaning schedules and managing inventory of office and cleaning supplies.

 

**Administrative Support:** Perform tasks such as filing, data entry, and assisting with tax return assembly to support organizational operations.

 

**Financial Tasks:** Process client payments using Remote Deposit Software, handle accounts payable, manage petty cash, and oversee employee postage.

 

**Client Support:** Provide clear and professional guidance to clients regarding tax filing instructions and requirements.

 

**Skills and Qualifications**

 

**Professionalism:** Demonstrate a polished demeanor, maintaining a high level of professionalism in all interactions.

 

**Education:** High school diploma or GED required.

 

**Experience:** Minimum of two years in customer service and administrative roles, with a proven track record of reliability and efficiency.

 

**Communication:** Exceptional verbal and written communication skills to engage effectively with clients, visitors, and team members.

 

**Independence and Teamwork:** Ability to work independently while contributing collaboratively to team objectives.

 

**Technical Proficiency:** Strong command of Microsoft 365 applications (Outlook, Excel, Word) and familiarity with office software systems.

 

**Organizational Skills:** Detail\-oriented with the ability to multitask, prioritize, and manage time effectively in a fast\-paced environment.

 

Job Type: Full\-time

 

Pay: $35,000\.00 \- $45,000\.00 per year

 

Benefits:

 

* 401(k) matching

* Dental insurance

* Health insurance

* Paid time off

* Vision insurance

 

Schedule:

 

* 8 hour shift

* Monday to Friday

 

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Administrative Assistant
jobs.description:
**Overview**

We are seeking a dedicated and organized Administrative Assistant to join our team. The ideal candidate will play a crucial role in ensuring smooth office operations and providing exceptional support to our staff and clients. This position requires strong communication skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple tasks efficiently in a fast\-paced environment.

 

**Responsibilities**

 

* Manage front desk operations, greeting visitors and directing them appropriately.

* Handle incoming calls with professionalism, utilizing effective phone etiquette.

* Maintain organized filing systems and ensure all documents are accurately processed and stored.

* Assist in scheduling appointments and managing calendars for team members.

* Provide customer support by addressing inquiries and resolving issues promptly.

* Utilize Google Workspace for document creation, data entry, and communication with team members.

* Perform clerical duties such as data entry, maintaining office supplies, and preparing reports as needed.

* Collaborate with other departments to ensure seamless office functionality.

 

**Skills**

 

* Proficient in Google Workspace applications (Docs, Sheets, Drive) and general computer literacy.

* Strong organizational skills with the ability to prioritize tasks effectively.

* Excellent phone systems knowledge and phone etiquette for professional communication.

* Previous experience as a clerk or medical receptionist is a plus but not required.

* Ability to provide outstanding customer support while maintaining a positive attitude.

* Strong attention to detail to ensure accuracy in all tasks performed.

 

Join our team as an Administrative Assistant where your contributions will be valued, and you will have the opportunity to grow within a supportive work environment!

 

\*\*APPLY BY SUBMITTING RESUME \- NO CALLS TO THE OFFICE WILL BE ACCEPTED\*\*

 

Job Type: Part\-time

 

Pay: $18\.00 \- $19\.00 per hour

 

Expected hours: 35 – 40 per week

 

Schedule:

 

* 8 hour shift

* Day shift

* Monday to Friday

* No nights

* No weekends

 

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Delray Beach, FL 33444

jobs.title: Personal Assistant
jobs.description:
**Job Title:** Personal Assistant – Wild West Plumbing (Real Estate, Service, Construction, Social Media)

 

**Job Type:** Full\-Time,

**Location:** 3114 SE Loop 820, Fort Worth, TX 76140 (some remote work may be possible)

**Salary:** Depends on experience

**Start Date:** ASAP

 

**Job Description:**

 

Wild West Plumbing is seeking a reliable and detail\-oriented Personal Assistant to support the business owner in managing three growing businesses: a plumbing service company, a small construction operation, and a real estate investment portfolio. This is a hands\-on, fast\-paced role for someone who is organized, adaptable, and ready to handle a mix of business and administrative tasks—with a touch of creativity in social media and marketing.

 

**Responsibilities include:**

 

* Managing the owner's schedule, calendar, and daily priorities

* Answering phones, responding to emails, and coordinating communication

* Assisting with job tracking, service calls, and coordinating with crews or vendors

* Running errands and supporting both business and personal tasks

* Organizing records including permits, invoices, contracts, and receipts

* Creating and scheduling basic social media content (Facebook, Instagram, etc.)

* Designing simple flyers or graphics (Canva or similar tools)

* Monitoring and responding to online reviews and customer inquiries

* Assisting with invoicing, light bookkeeping, or data entry (training available)

* Helping promote and support the Wild West Plumbing brand across all platforms

 

**Qualifications:**

 

* Strong organizational and multitasking skills

* Professional communication and customer service skills

* Comfortable with Google Workspace, Microsoft Office, and social media platforms

* Willingness to learn industry\-specific tasks in plumbing, real estate, and construction

* Dependable and able to work independently

* Must have reliable transportation and a valid driver’s license

* Must be authorized to work in the U.S.

 

**Preferred but not required:**

 

* Experience in service businesses or office administration

* Familiarity with QuickBooks, Canva, or job tracking software

* Prior work in social media management or marketing

* Knowledge of real estate or basic construction operations

 

**Benefits:**

 

* Flexible work schedule

* Paid time off after probationary period

* Growth potential within multiple business industries

* Supportive and entrepreneurial work environment

 

**To apply:**

 

Please submit your resume and a short message introducing yourself. If you have experience with social media or marketing, feel free to include links or samples of your work.

 

Job Type: Full\-time

 

Pay: $15\.00 \- $25\.00 per hour

 

Expected hours: 40 – 50 per week

 

Benefits:

 

* 401(k) matching

* Dental insurance

* Employee discount

* Flexible schedule

* Health insurance

* Life insurance

* Paid time off

* Referral program

* Vision insurance

 

Schedule:

 

* 8 hour shift

* Monday to Friday

 

People with a criminal record are encouraged to apply

 

Ability to Commute:

 

* Fort Worth, TX 76140 (Required)

 

Ability to Relocate:

 

* Fort Worth, TX 76140: Relocate before starting work (Required)

 

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Operations Coordinator/Administrative Assistant
jobs.description:
**Job Summary**

 

Blue Cypress Consulting is seeking a responsible and self\-motivated individual for a 15 to 20 hour part\-time Operations Coordinator position for a community planning and engineering small business in Decatur. We are looking for someone with outstanding verbal and written communication and interpersonal skills. Must be detail oriented and able to prioritize, multitask, and organize projects. A candidate with enthusiasm, professionalism, flexibility, and creativity will be a good fit for our team. The successful candidate will have demonstrable experience with Microsoft Office particularly with Excel, Word, and PowerPoint. Additional software experience with Unanet or other accounting software is preferred. They should thrive in a fast\-paced environment and exemplify Blue Cypress’s core values: Collaborative, Strategic, and Improvement\-Oriented.

 

**Qualifications**

 

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential function mentioned satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills, and/or abilities required. Necessary accommodations will be provided in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act and state or local law.

 

The statements in this job description are intended to describe the essential nature and level of work being performed. They are not intended to list ALL responsibilities or qualifications of the job.

 

**Responsibilities Include:**

 

· Assist accounting, operations, marketing, and project staff on a daily basis

 

· Data Entry

 

· Post cash receipts

 

· Input accounts payable, credit card receipts, weekly bank records

 

· Open, sort, and distribute mail; identify priority items

 

· Monitor and order office inventory

 

· Keep Decatur office organized

 

· Schedule meetings

 

· Scanning and physical and digital filing and organization

 

· Assist with completing timesheets

 

· Assist leadership team with submitting expense reports

 

· Track and research professional organizations and upcoming awards, conferences, and events

 

· Input information into CRM for marketing group

 

· Assist marketing with completing proposal forms

 

· Sponsorship tracking

 

· Process certificates of insurance

 

· Report updates

 

· Prepare slide decks

 

· Assist with event planning on an as\-needed basis

 

· Travel bookings as requested

 

· Other operational duties as requested

 

**Minimum Qualifications Include:**

 

· Associate’s degree

 

· 5 years of related professional administrative experience

 

· Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite

 

· Proficiency in Microsoft Excel is a must

 

· Strong attention to detail

 

· Effective and personable verbal and written communication abilities with strong follow\-up skills

 

· Flexibility and ability to prioritize and handle multiple tasks and collaborate with various managers in a fast\-paced environment

 

· Ability to receive and act upon constructive feedback

 

· Must maintain confidentiality of sensitive information

 

· Ability to assist with the overall administrative needs of a growing 30\-person business with multiple office locations

 

· Enthusiasm, professionalism, creativity, and strong interpersonal skills

 

· A strong work ethic and positive commitment to being an active participant in our small business culture is a must

 

· Must be authorized to work in the United States

 

**Preferred Qualifications Include:**

 

· Experience working in the architecture / engineering industry

 

· Certified as a notary

 

**Required Software Proficiencies Include:**

 

· Microsoft Office Suite including Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and OneNote

 

**Preferred Software Proficiencies Include:**

 

· Unanet, or other similar ERPs such as Deltek

 

· Paychex, or other similar PEO websites

 

**Supervisory Responsibilities**

 

This position is not responsible for supervising other employees.

 

**Travel**

 

There is no travel expected for this position.

 

**Work Authorization**

 

Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa at this time.

 

**Work Environment**

 

The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job.

 

This is a hybrid position (in office/remote). We offer a telecommute option to work once a week from the office, with a minimum of 6 times per month at the office, and the remainder of the time to work from home. If desired, employees may work up to every day in the office instead of at home. During onboarding, new hires may be required to work more frequently in\-person at the office with their supervisor. While in the office, the employee will normally work in a temperature\-controlled office environment, with frequent exposure to electronic office equipment. Smoking and vaping shall be prohibited in all enclosed areas within the workplace.

 

**Physical Demands**

 

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

 

* Prolonged periods sitting at a desk and working on a computer

* Must be able to lift up to 15 pounds at times

 

**Company Profile**

 

Blue Cypress Consulting is a vibrant and growing firm based in Decatur, GA, with a growing office in Seattle, WA. Formed in 2013, the firm provides clients with best\-in\-class infrastructure management and community planning consulting services. Below are our Core Values:

 

· **Collaborative**: We work together to create unified solutions by respectfully embracing diverse perspectives, acting on constructive feedback, and developing shared goals.

 

· **Strategic**: We make thoughtful, forward\-thinking decisions that align with well\-defined goals, prioritize long\-term impacts, and optimize resources to achieve meaningful outcomes for our company and clients.

 

· **Improvement\-Oriented**: We focus on positive growth, innovative problem\-solving, and the continuous enhancement of efficiency and quality for our team and clients by seeking and embracing feedback and reflecting on successes and opportunities for development.

 

We add value through responsiveness; a focus on innovation; offering honest, respectful, and well\-thought\-through advice; and high\-end analytical services. We strive to stay sharp, monitor and set trends, and think outside the box to offer fresh ideas to our clients. We sweat the details, while keeping our eye on the strategic horizon. Above all, quality and integrity are the touchstones of Blue Cypress culture.

 

**Employee Development – Our Philosophy**

 

We believe in helping our employees align their energy with their passion. We believe in setting our employees up for success by providing structure to develop their careers. We believe in mentorship that nurtures passion and challenges the intellect. We embrace the entrepreneurial spirit and are seeking a candidate with the same passion for making our company their own and changing the world. We support getting involved in community and trade organizations, attending career related training opportunities, and attending conferences to present and to learn.

 

**Benefits of Working with Us**

 

Blue Cypress Consulting has received recognition as a Best Place to Work by the Atlanta Business Chronicle. Our commitment to our team members and the company culture is a top priority. At Blue Cypress Consulting, we offer flexible work arrangements/schedules and strive to promote work/life balance. We utilize remote working tools such as screen sharing and professional conference calling equipment, as well as cloud file storage, enabling our consultants access to their team and data from any client site. We offer a retirement account matching program.

 

The Ministry of Culture (MOC) at Blue Cypress is an employee\-driven, management\-supported effort that provides a place to guide company culture, promote team building, and create a positive work environment that makes employees feel valued and appreciated. The MOC currently implements the following four initiatives:

 

· Team Building

 

· Community

 

· Involvement Enrichment

 

· Wellness \& Environmental

 

**Affirmative Action/EEO Statement**

 

Blue Cypress Consulting provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.

 

**Additional Information**

 

This job description in no way states or implies that these are the only duties to be performed by the employee filling this position. The employee will be required to follow any other job\-related instructions and to perform any other job\-related duties requested by management. Management has the right to add to, revise, or delete information in this job description. Reasonable accommodation will be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of this position.

 

This document does not create an employment contract, implied or otherwise, other than an “at will” employment relationship.

 

*The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. The statements above are not intended to be construed as an exhaustive list of all the responsibilities, duties, and skills required.*

 

Job Type: Part\-time

 

Pay: $20\.00 \- $24\.00 per hour

 

Expected hours: 15 – 20 per week

 

Benefits:

 

* Flexible schedule

 

Schedule:

 

* Monday to Friday

* No nights

* No weekends

 

Application Question(s):

 

* Please submit a cover letter explaining why you are a good fit for Blue Cypress Consulting. Resumes without cover letters will not be considered.

 

Do you require sponsorship now or in the future? Please respond "yes" or "no".

 

Education:

 

* Associate (Required)

 

Experience:

 

* professional administrative: 5 years (Required)

* Microsoft Office: 1 year (Required)

* Microsoft Excel: 1 year (Required)

* Microsoft PowerPoint: 1 year (Required)

* Microsoft OneNote: 1 year (Preferred)

* ERP systems/Unanet/Deltek: 1 year (Preferred)

* PEO/Paychex: 1 year (Preferred)

 

Ability to Commute:

 

* Decatur, GA 30030 (Required)

 

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Decatur, GA 30030

**Real Estate Assistant job description** specifically for our wholesaling/off\-market real estate business lead by James Graham, Real Estate Agent \& The Quatra Group brokered by NJ Capital Realty:

 

**Job Title:** Licensed Real Estate Assistant –

**Location:** \[Burlington, NJ / Remote / Hybrid]

**Job Type:** \[Full\-Time / Part\-Time / Contract]

**Reports To:** Real Estate Agent Consultant

 

**Job Summary:**

 

We are looking for a detail\-oriented and driven Real Estate Assistant to support our fast\-paced off\-market real estate and wholesaling business. The ideal candidate will help manage lead generation, client outreach, marketing efforts, and transaction coordination. This role requires strong organizational skills, follow\-up discipline, and a proactive mindset to keep deals moving forward.

 

**Key Responsibilities:**

 

* Manage and update CRM systems with seller and buyer leads

* Assist in skip tracing, cold call follow\-ups, and outbound text/email campaigns

* Coordinate appointments for property walkthroughs, inspections, and seller meetings

* Research property ownership, tax records, and comparable sales (comps)

* Communicate with sellers, buyers, and title companies to assist in closing deals

* Prepare contracts of sale, assignment contracts, purchase agreements, and disclosures

* Monitor pipeline progress and help track KPIs and marketing metrics

* Create marketing materials for dispositions (email blasts, flyers, investor lists)

* Maintain buyer’s list and assist in matching deals with potential investors

* Help organize digital files, contracts, and transaction paperwork

 

**Qualifications:**

 

* Prior experience in real estate, wholesaling, or investor support is a strong plus

* Familiarity with tools like PropStream, BatchLeads, REI Reply, or similar

* Strong administrative and communication skills

* Comfortable with high\-volume outbound communication (calls/texts/emails)

* Self\-starter who can work independently and meet deadlines

* Real estate license is required

* Tech\-savvy and detail\-oriented with basic data entry and research skills

 

**Working Conditions:**

 

* \[Remote / Hybrid / On\-site in Burlington, NJ]

* Flexible schedule, but availability during normal business hours is expected

* Occasional evenings/weekends depending on deal flow

 

**Compensation:**

 

* Commission Percentage or flat rate per closed deal

 

**To Apply:**

Send your resume and a short message explaining your interest to info@quatraestates.com. Prior experience with wholesaling or investment real estate is highly preferred.

 

Job Types: Part\-time, Contract

 

Pay: $1,250\.00 \- $5,000\.00 per month

 

Benefits:

 

* Flexible schedule

* Professional development assistance

 

Schedule:

 

* On call

 

Education:

 

* High school or equivalent (Preferred)

 

Experience:

 

* Real estate administrative: 5 years (Preferred)

 

License/Certification:

 

* Real Estate License (Required)

 

Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Temporary Purchasing Assistant
jobs.description:
We are looking for a talented and highly motivated Purchasing Assistant to join our Purchasing Team. This role is responsible for following up on a high volume of purchase orders. They will record order confirmations and status, follow up on and resolve issues with purchase orders, and act as a liaison between our outside vendors and our internal Sales and Customer Service Teams.

 

\*\*This **temporary position** will be based out of our branch in Warwick, RI and will report to the Purchasing Manager\*\*

 

**Responsibilities:**

 

* Adequately and efficiently process and record a high volume of emailed order confirmations, estimated ship dates and tracking of purchase orders

* Answer inbound phone calls from vendors and suppliers

* Research and resolve issues with open purchase orders

* Follow up with vendors and suppliers on purchase orders to supply payment, obtain status, request invoices, and confirm product deliveries

* Develop, foster, and maintain excellent relationships with vendors and suppliers

* Accurately and effectively communicate with internal sales teams regarding status of or issues with purchase orders

* Perform other miscellaneous tasks and projects assigned by the Purchasing Manager

 

**Requirements:**

 

* High school diploma or GED, Associates’ preferred

* 1\-3 years of purchasing experience

* Previous purchasing experience in healthcare industry a plus

* Excellent grammar, verbal, written, and data entry skills

* Intermediate level proficiency in Microsoft Office (Outlook, Word, Excel)

* Knowledgeable in A\+ and Salesforce software a plus

 

**Who you are:**

 

* Positive team player with a strong and consistent work ethic

* Comfortable working in a high paced work environment

* Exercise good judgment to determine appropriate action

* Problem solver, highly organized, and strong attention to detail

* Proactive in identifying opportunities for improvement and driving process improvements

 

**About CME Corp:**

 

Dedicated to providing quality equipment, logistics, and services to healthcare. CME Corp is the premier source for equipment and turnkey logistics, delivery, and support for the healthcare community. The company helps healthcare facilities nationwide to seamlessly launch, renovate and expand. CME Corp is headquartered in Warwick, RI with branches in Anaheim, CA, and Long Island, NY and over 35\+ service centers spanning the nation and offers an expanded product line of more than 2 million\+ medical products from more than 2,000 manufacturers.

 

We support our military community, veterans encouraged to apply!

 

CME Corp is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applications from all backgrounds regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, ancestry, age, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, disability, or any other classification protected by law.

 

Job Types: Full\-time, Temporary

 

Pay: $20\.00 \- $21\.00 per hour

 

Schedule:

 

* 8 hour shift

* Monday to Friday

 

Education:

 

* Associate (Preferred)

 

Experience:

 

* Purchasing: 2 years (Preferred)

* Administrative: 2 years (Preferred)

* Customer service: 2 years (Preferred)

* High volume purchase order: 2 years (Preferred)

* Data entry: 2 years (Preferred)

 

Ability to Commute:

 

* Warwick, RI 02886 (Required)

 

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Warwick, RI 02886

Summary of Job Duties:

The Program Assistant for the 100 Families Initiative plays a vital support role by serving as the initial point of contact for incoming referrals, coordinating the intake and assignment process, and ensuring seamless communication and follow\-up between clients, family advocates, and the broader initiative team. This position also provides administrative and scheduling support to the 100 Families Coordinator and assists with communication and logistics related to local alliance meetings and community collaboration efforts.

 

Qualifications:

Qualifications:

 

* High school diploma or equivalent required; some college or relevant training preferred.

* Effective communication and interpersonal skills, with a compassionate, client\-centered approach.

* Experience working in human services, community outreach, or administrative support roles preferred.

* Proficiency with email, calendars, and basic data entry systems (e.g., Google Workspace, Microsoft Office, and case management tools).

* Excellent organizational and time management skills.

* Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

 

Key Responsibilities:

Referral Intake \& Client Support* Receive and review referrals for the 100 Families Initiative.

* Screen referrals for appropriateness and completeness using established criteria.

* Assign referrals to Family Advocates based on caseload, availability, and family needs.

* Serve as first contact for referred families and individuals; provide information, support, and resource referrals as needed.

* Follow up with clients regularly to ensure engagement and to identify additional service needs.

 

 

Team \& Administrative Support:* Assist the 100 Families Coordinator in maintaining and updating email distribution lists for alliance meetings and communications.

* Draft and send meeting invitations, reminders, and follow\-up communications using email and calendar platforms (e.g., Outlook, Google Calendar).

* Monitor the Coordinator’s calendar, help manage scheduling and send out calendar invitations as needed.

* Support Family Advocates and the Coordinator with documentation, logistics, and administrative tasks as assigned.

* Ensure accurate records are maintained in program systems, including data entry and tracking of referral assignments.

 

 

Collaboration \& Communication:* Coordinate with community partners and referring agencies to ensure timely responses to referrals.

* Attend alliance meetings and internal team meetings as needed, take notes and assist with coordination.

* Contribute to a positive, team\-oriented environment that supports collaboration and the mission of the 100 Families Initiative.

 

 

 

Additional Information:

Preferred Skills:* Bilingual (Spanish/English or Marshallese/English) is a plus.

* Familiarity with the 100 Families Initiative or similar collaborative, multi\-agency models.

jobs.title: Department Assistant 3
jobs.description:
**Salary Grade**

  • ----------------

    •  

     

     

     

    Case Western Reserve University is committed to providing a transparent estimate of the salary for this position at the time of its posting. The starting wage rate is $19\.41 per hour.

     

     

    Employees receive more than just a paycheck. University employees enjoy a comprehensive benefits package that includes excellent healthcare, retirement plans, tuition assistance, paid time off, and a winter recess.

     

     

    **Job Description**

  • -------------------

    •  

     

     

     

    POSITION OBJECTIVE

     

     

    Working under the general direction of the program director, provide administrative support to the program director and Master¿s in Nursing program with a moderate degree of independence. The department assistant is responsible for the overall smooth functioning of the program. Assignments may be long term and require the individual to rely on their own resources and ability to work independently in task accomplishments.

     

     

     

    ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

     

    * Serve as staff assistant to the program director in all matters relating to the program including maintaining calendars and coordinating travel arrangements as requested. Initiate and follow up on routine correspondence. Process confidential information and communication. Perform a variety of clerical duties and document preparation with speed and accuracy. Facilitate program dealings with others in the school, university and community. Provide committee support: arrange monthly meetings, including space and refreshments as needed; communicate information regarding upcoming meetings including appropriate agenda; transcribe and distribute minutes accordingly from faculty meetings and program faculty. Provide clerical support as needed, including assistance to all faculty teaching in program, as well as for the France Payne Bolton School of Nursing Receptionist. Maintain office supply inventory. Serve as staff support for other assigned schools of nursing standing committees (40%).

    * Maintain relevant student records and databases to ensure continuous compliance with regulatory and accreditation requirements and work with the department of Institutional Research in support of maintaining and updating these documents. Maintain records of student compliance with immunization requirements, CPR/first aid certifications, clinical assignments, progress through the program and learning contracts, student statistics and contact information, evidence of criminal checks and fingerprinting, contact information and clinical compliance. Ensure records are accurate and timely. Promote quality student experience and connection with alumni by serving as the face and point of contact for the program. Demonstrate professional and supportive responses to student communications and concerns. Facilitate surveys and interactions with alumni, support recruitment events, and coordinate student engagement events. Complete verification of all requirements for clinical experiences with accuracy and timeliness. Maintain clear and professional communication with the program director, students, faculty, staff, administration and other visitors/vendors. Provide letters of completion to Boards of Nursing for each graduating student when cleared by the program director. Work with student recruitment and admissions staff, as well as marketing and communication departments. Maintain and track web page entries and accuracy of the program website. Remind each potential student the importance of completing the checklist prior to orientation and matriculation. Assist faculty with preparation for new student orientation including rooms/organizing venues. Will also be responsible for contacting vendors, ordering food, flowers, etc. Assist faculty and staff with any required paperwork. Trigger beginning and end of semester processes that include syllabi review, preceptor verification, and evaluation forms from student, faculty and clinical instructors. (35%)

    * Analyze accounting/bookkeeping records for the department. May authorize routine department expenditures. Prepare all invoices and reimbursements related to the programs for processing. Contribute to ongoing audits, monitoring and evaluation. Assist in preparation of budgets and fiscal reports, maintain accounting/ bookkeeping for department, reconcile monthly expense statements, and perform data and budget analysis and forecasting. (20%)

     

     

     

    NONESSENTIAL FUNCITONS

     

     

    Perform other duties as assigned. (5%)

     

     

     

    CONTACTS

     

     

    Department: Daily contact with program director, faculty and departmental staff. Students: Daily contact with students to exchange information.

     

     

    University: Contact with other university departments on an as needed basis. External: Contact with travel and accommodation vendors and partnering institutions to exchange relevant information.

     

     

     

    SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES

     

     

    This position has no direct supervision of staff employees.

     

     

     

    QUALIFICAITONS

     

     

    Experience: Minimum of 5 years of related clerical experience required. Education/ Licensing: High school education required, college education preferred

     

     

     

    REQUIRED SKILLS

     

    * Communication Skills. Understand written sentences and paragraphs in work related documents. Give full attention to what other people are saying, take time to understand the points being made, ask clarification questions if needed. Communicate effectively verbally and in writing as appropriate with the program director, students, faculty, staff, university and external vendors. Notify the program director of any concerns related to student safety, or student failure to provide compliance documentation

    * The ability to interact with colleagues, supervisors, and customers face to face in a professional manner.

    * Ability to generate documents in Word, PowerPoint and Excel. Ability to work in Qualtrix and other on\-line survey applications. Ability to run basic analytics and generate reports in a variety of programs.

    * Ability to actively learn and understand the implications of new information for both current and future problem\-solving and decision\-making.

    * Ability to operate copy, fax machines and Scan Tron to perform calculations and produce documents.

    * Adhere to all relevant university policies and procedures.

    * Demonstrated history of successful support, education, and advocacy for all students, aligned with the values, mission, and messaging of the university, while adhering to the staff policy on conflict of commitment and interest.

    * Ability to meet consistent attendance.

    * Ability to interact with colleagues, supervisors, and customers face to face.

     

     

     

    WORKING CONDITIONS

     

     

    General office environment. The employee will perform repetitive motion using a computer mouse and keyboard to type.

     

     

    **Hybrid Eligibility**

  • ----------------------

    •  

     

     

     

    This position is eligible for hybrid work arrangement up to two remote days per week at the discretion of the department. New employees may begin a hybrid schedule upon approval from the supervisor, successful completion of an orientation period and signing the remote work checklist certification form.

     

     

    **EEO Statement**

  • -----------------

    •  

     

     

     

    Case Western Reserve University is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants are protected under federal and state laws and university policy from discrimination based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national or ethnic origin, protected veteran status, disability, age and genetic information.

     

     

    **Reasonable Accommodations**

  • -----------------------------

    •  

     

     

     

    Case Western Reserve University complies with the Americans with Disabilities Act regarding reasonable accommodations for applicants with disabilities. Applicants requiring a reasonable accommodation for any part of the application and hiring process should contact the CWRU Office of Equity at 216\-368\-3066 to request a reasonable accommodation. Determinations as to granting reasonable accommodations for any applicants will be made on a case\-by\-case basis.

     

     

    .

jobs.title: Nursing Assistant - Float Pool
jobs.description:
**Duties**

  • ----------

    •  

     

    **The Float Pool NA is responsible for the evidence\-based care of a group of patients as follows:**

     

     

    * Assists the RN, licensed practical nurse (LPN), and other members of the interdisciplinary team (IDT) with providing input in the development of care plan based on the Veterans care needs. This includes input into completion of the minimum data set (MDS) assessment at required and various time points.

    * Attends IDT meetings and contributes to the IDT.

    * Performs support duties for diagnostic procedures, which include preparing the Veteran and monitoring the Veteran's condition.

    * Performs nursing care, as applicable to the Veteran, including all aspects of personal care and grooming.

    * Under the direction of the RN or LPN, monitor bladder and bowel functioning, tracking of I\&O and hydration.

    * Under the direction of the RN or LPN, provides health care services to the Veteran to include, **but not limited to:** Foley Catheter insertion/discontinuation/care; obtaining the Veteran's vital signs, blood glucose, or electrocardiogram (EKG); activities of daily living; and post mortem care.

    * Under the direction of the RN or LPN, monitor psychiatric symptoms, assisting in medical and psychiatric emergencies.

    * Maintain patient safety and the safety of the environment.

    * Provide one\-to\-one observations to ensure patient safety.

    * The NA float can work in multiple areas include Intensive Care Unit (ICU), Emergency Department (ED), Ambulatory Surgical Unit(ASU)/Post Anesthesia Care Unit (PACU), Medical/Surgical/Telemetry(Med/Surg/Tele), Short Stay Rehabilitation, Nursing Home, Hospice, Inpatient Acute Psychiatry Unit, Residential Rehabilitation and Treatment Program (RRTP), or outpatient clinics, and must maintain competencies in all areas.

    * Performs other duties as assigned

     

    **Work Schedule**: 4:00 p.m. \- Midnight, with rotation including weekends and holidays

     

    **Telework**: Not Available

     

    **Virtual:** This is not a virtual position.

     

    **Financial Disclosure Report:** Not required

     

    **Requirements**

  • ----------------

    •  

     

    ### **Conditions of Employment**

     

     

    * You must be a U.S. Citizen to apply for this job.

    * All applicants tentatively selected for VA employment in a testing designated position are subject to urinalysis to screen for illegal drug use prior to appointment. Applicants who refuse to be tested will be denied employment with VA.

    * Selective Service Registration is required for males born after 12/31/1959\.

    * Must be proficient in written and spoken English.

    * You may be required to serve a probationary period.

    * Subject to background/security investigation.

    * Selected applicants will be required to complete an online onboarding process. Acceptable form(s) of identification will be required to complete pre\-employment requirements (https://www.uscis.gov/i\-9\-central/form\-i\-9\-acceptable\-documents). Effective May 7, 2025, driver's licenses or state\-issued dentification cards that are not REAL ID compliant cannot be utilized as an acceptable form of identification for employment.

    * Participation in the seasonal influenza vaccination program is a requirement for all Department of Veterans Affairs Health Care Personnel (HCP).

     

     

    ### **Qualifications**

     

     

    Applicants pending the completion of educational or certification/licensure requirements may be referred and tentatively selected but may not be hired until all requirements are met.

     

     

     

    **Basic Requirements**:

    * United States Citizenship: Non\-citizens may only be appointed when it is not possible to recruit qualified citizens in accordance with VA Policy.

    * Experience or] Education or Training.(1\) Six months of general experience. Experience must demonstrate the ability to acquire the knowledge and skills to perform the work of a NA;OR,](2\) One year of education above high school with courses related to the NA occupation; OR,(3\) Completion of an intensive, specialized, occupation\-related \[training]course of study \[or program] of less than one year as a NA may also meet in full the experience requirements for GS\-3\.

     

    May qualify based on being covered by the Grandfathering Provision as described in the VA Qualification Standard for this occupation (only applicable to current VHA employees who are in this occupation and meet the criteria).

     

     

     

    **Grade Determinations**: In addition to the basic requirements for employment, the following criteria must be met when determining the grade of candidates.

     

     

     

    **GS\-3 Nursing Assistant**

     

    (a) Experience and Education. None beyond the basic requirements.(b) Assignments. Individuals assigned as GS\-3 NAs are considered to be at the entry level and are closely supervised.

     

     

     

    **GS\-4 Nursing Assistant**

     

    (a)Experience. One year of specialized experience as a NA or experience in another medical field (licensed practical nurse, health technician, hospital corpsman, etc.), performing technical and nursing skills requiring knowledge of the human physical and emotional states, therapeutic communication, and technical skills required for basic and intermediate treatments;

     

    OR,

     

    (b)Education. Successful completion of 2 years above high school in an accredited institution with courses related to nursing care, healthcare or in a field of study appropriate to the specialization of the position, such as education in a program for psychology, psychiatric or operating room technicians; AND

     

    Demonstrated Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities (KSAs). In addition, the candidate must demonstrate the following KSAs:

     

    i Ability to provide a range of patient/resident care and contribute to the completion of the nurse care plan and recovery of patients/residents.

     

    ii Ability to observe patients/residents' or resident's physical or emotional status and refer deviations and/or problems to supervisor in a timely manner.

     

    iii Ability to properly use equipment, materials and supplies in simple diagnostic and treatment procedures such as bladder scan, continuous passive motion device, blood glucose monitoring machine, specimen collection, etc.

     

    iv Ability to communicate effectively with patients/residents, their families and other health professionals.

     

     

     

    **GS\-5 Nursing Assistant**(a) Experience. One year of progressively responsible assignments and experience equivalent to the GS\-4 level which demonstrates knowledge, skills, and abilities that are directly related to the specific assignment. In addition, the candidate must demonstrate the professional KSAs in subparagraph (c) below;

     

    OR,

     

    Education. Successful completion of a 4\-year course of study above high school leading to a bachelor's degree that included 24 semester hours of courses related to health care or possession of a bachelor's degree;

     

    AND

     

    (c) Demonstrated KSAs.

     

    i Ability to assist in the full range of nursing care to patients/residents with physical and/or behavioral problems in a hospital, long\-term care or outpatient setting under the direction of a Registered Nurse and/or Licensed Vocational Nurse/Licensed Practical Nurse.

     

    ii Ability to communicate orally with patients/residents, families, interdisciplinary team and other personnel. This includes serving as a preceptor to new NAs by assisting with the coordination of their orientation and overseeing/assessing their practical experience while in a clinical setting.

     

    iii Ability to recognize and react to emergent patient/resident care situations and intervene while waiting for assistance. For example, recognizing need for basic life support, controlling bleeding and assisting with behavior crisis, etc.

     

     

     

    **Preferred Experience:** At least two years nursing assistant experience preferred. Inpatient experience a plus.

     

     

     

    **Reference:** For more information on this qualification standard, please visit https://www.va.gov/ohrm/QualificationStandards/.

    ### **Education**

     

     

    **Note:** Only education or degrees recognized by the U.S. Department of Education from accredited colleges, universities, schools, or institutions may be used to qualify for Federal employment. You can verify your education here: http://ope.ed.gov/accreditation/. If you are using foreign education to meet qualification requirements, you must send a Certificate of Foreign Equivalency with your transcript in order to receive credit for that education. For further information, visit: https://sites.ed.gov/international/recognition\-of\-foreign\-qualifications/.

     

     

    ### **Additional information**

     

     

    Receiving Service Credit or Earning Annual (Vacation) Leave: Federal Employees earn annual leave at a rate (4, 6 or 8 hours per pay period) which is based on the number of years they have served as a Federal employee. Selected applicants may qualify for credit toward annual leave accrual, based on prior work experience or military service experience. This credited service can be used in determining the rate at which they earn annual leave. Such credit must be requested and approved prior to the appointment date and is not guaranteed.

     

     

     

    During the application process you may have an option to opt\-in to make your resume available to hiring managers in the agency who have similar positions. Opting in does not impact your application for this announcement, nor does it guarantee further consideration for additional positions.

     

     

     

    This job opportunity announcement may be used to fill additional vacancies.

     

     

     

    This position is in the Excepted Service and does not confer competitive status.

     

     

     

    VA encourages persons with disabilities to apply. The health\-related positions in VA are covered by Title 38, and are not covered by the Schedule A excepted appointment authority.

     

     

     

    If you are unable to apply online or need an alternate method to submit documents, please reach out to the Agency Contact listed in this Job Opportunity Announcement.

     

     

     

    Under the Fair Chance to Compete Act, the Department of Veterans Affairs prohibits requesting an applicant's criminal history prior to accepting a tentative job offer. For more information about the Act and the complaint process, visit Human Resources and Administration/Operations, Security, and Preparedness (HRA/OSP) at The Fair Chance Act.

     

     

     

     

    * Benefits

     

     

     

    A career with the U.S. government provides employees with a comprehensive benefits package. As a federal employee, you and your family will have access to a range of benefits that are designed to make your federal career very rewarding. Opens in a new windowLearn more about federal benefits.

     

     

    Review our benefits

     

     

    Eligibility for benefits depends on the type of position you hold and whether your position is full\-time, part\-time or intermittent. Contact the hiring agency for more information on the specific benefits offered.

    **How You Will Be Evaluated**

jobs.descriptionText: **Duties** ----------     **The Float Pool NA is responsible for the evidence\-based care of a group of patients as follows:**     * Assists the RN, licensed practical nurse (LPN), and other members of the interdisciplinary team (IDT) with providing input in the development of care plan based on the Veterans care needs. jobs.description:
**Duties**

  • ----------

    •  

     

    Total Rewards of a Allied Health Professional

     

     

     

    **Major duties include but are not limited to:**

     

     

    * Scheduling and rescheduling patients for treatment; interviewing patients for appointments;

    * Referring patients to other medical specialty clinics

    * Perform front desk duties, receives telephone calls, and visitors to the MSA unit

    * Providing information to patients necessary to resolve complaints

    * Interacting with both internal and external customers

    * Reviewing and documenting medical outpatient and inpatient electronic health records, as well as administrative records

    * Verifying third party insurance and updating information in the Insurance Capture Buffer (ICB) system

    * Obtaining medical information from patients

    * Coordinating information and actions related to patient care and services

    * Scheduling appointments in accordance with VHA national scheduling guidelines

    * Consult with clinic staff when processing physician scheduling and administrative orders.

    * Advises clinical staff on current administrative processes

    * Relaying messages to appropriate staff inside or outside of the unit, scheduling appointments, including interpreting, and verifying provider orders in accordance with VHA national scheduling guidelines.

    * Entering no\-show information

    * Monitoring appointment requests from multiple electronic sources

    * Participating in huddles with other MSAs and/or clinic staff to determine the daily needs of the clinic

    * Monitoring both inpatient and outpatient appointments in areas of responsibility

    * Verifying and updating demographics and insurance information when patients check\-in for appointments

    * Coordinates administrative functions relating to emergency and non\-emergency transfers to other VA facilities or private hospitals and determines appointment type based on the patient's eligibility status (i.e., TRICARE, sharing agreements, collaterals, research patient, VA employee, etc.

     

    **Work Schedule**: Monday\-Friday, 7:30am\-4:00pm

     

    **Recruitment Incentive (Sign\-on Bonus):** Not Authorized

     

    **Permanent Change of Station (Relocation Assistance):** Not Authorized

     

    **Pay:** Competitive salary and regular salary increases

     

    **Paid Time Off:** 37\-50 days of annual paid time offer per year (13\-26 days of annual leave, 13 days of sick leave, 11 paid Federal holidays per year)

     

    Selected applicants may qualify for credit toward annual leave accrual, based on prior work experience or military service experience.

     

    **Parental Leave:** After 12 months of employment, up to 12 weeks of paid parental leave in connection with the birth, adoption, or foster care placement of a child.

     

    **Child Care Subsidy:** After 60 days of employment, full time employees with a total family income below $144,000 may be eligible for a childcare subsidy up to 25% of total eligible childcare costs for eligible children up to the monthly maximum of $416\.66**.**

     

    **Retirement:** Traditional federal pension (5 years vesting) and federal 401K with up to 5% in contributions by VA

     

    **Insurance:** Federal health/vision/dental/term life/long\-term care (many federal insurance programs can be carried into retirement)

     

    **Telework**: Not Available

     

    **Virtual:** This is not a virtual position.

    **PCS Appraised Value Offer (AVO):** Not Authorized

    * Selective Service Registration is required for males born after 12/31/1959\.

    **Basic Requirements**:

    * **Experience and Education.**

    + **Education.** One year above high school; **OR**,

    + **Experience/Education Combination.** Equivalent combination of experience and education are qualifying for entry level for which both education and experience are acceptable.

    * **Foreign Education.** To be creditable, education completed outside the U.S. must have been submitted to a private organization that specializes in the interpretation of foreign educational credentials and such education must have been deemed at least equivalent to that gained in conventional U.S. programs.

    + Ability to meet, communicate, and interact with individuals in a courteous and helpful manner in order to give instructions and arrange appointments.

    + Ability to utilize computer systems to enter administrative data in patient systems.

    + Ability to learn and utilize basic medical terminology to record patient messages and physician requests pertaining to follow\-up medical care.

     

    **Grade Determination GS\-4 MSA (Developmental Level)**

    * **Experience:** One year of experience in clerical, office, customer service, or other administrative work that indicates the ability to acquire the particular knowledge and skills needed to perform the duties of the position. Examples of experience include but are not necessarily limited to: Meet, communicate, and interact with individuals in a courteous and helpful manner in order to give instructions and arrange appointments, Utilize computer systems to enter administrative data in patient systems, Learn and utilize basic medical terminology to record patient messages and physician requests pertaining to follow\-up medical care

     

    **OR**

    * **Education:** Two years above high school.

     

    **AND**

    * **Demonstrated Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities.** **In addition to Basic Requirements and the experience listed above**, candidates must be able to demonstrate all of the KSAs below:

    + Ability to meet, communicate, and interact with individuals from varying backgrounds and other health care team members in a courteous and helpful manner in order to facilitate medical care for patients.

    + Ability to use, and navigate between, various types of office automation equipment and software (i.e. computer systems, web based scheduling programs; insurance collection system; scanning software, multiple line phone systems; electronic faxing programs) to support patient care.

    + Knowledge of basic medical terminology to assist in the provision of care to patients.

    + Skill in recording patient messages and understanding physician requests pertaining to follow\-up medical care in internal or external clinics.

     

    **Grade Determination GS\-5 MSA (Full Performance Level)**

    * **Experience:** One year of experience equivalent to the GS\-4 grade level.     * **Education:** Four years of education above high school.

    + Ability to operate computerized programs and systems in order to enter, modify, and retrieve sensitive medical and patient identifying information (PII) into or from electronic health records, scheduling systems, and/or reports.

    + Advanced knowledge of medical terminology specific to understand medical diagnosis and procedures sufficient to communicate clinical staff instructions to patients.

    + Ability to schedule medical appointments in a clinical setting.

    + Ability to work independently in the accomplishment of a wide variety of duties performing patient support work.

    + Skill in customer service with the ability to identify customer concerns, and refer to the appropriate staff as necessary, to ensure a satisfactory resolution.

    **NOTE:** Participation in the seasonal influenza program is a condition of employment and a requirement for all Department of Veterans Affairs Health Care Personnel (HCP). Wearing a face mask is required when an exemption to the influenza vaccination has been granted. HCP in violation of this directive may face disciplinary action up to and including removal from federal service. HCP are individuals who, during the influenza season, work in VHA locations or who come into contact with VA patients or other HCP as part of their duties. VHA locations include, but are not limited to, VA hospitals and associated clinics, community living centers (CLCs), community\-based outpatient clinics (CBOCs), domiciliary units, Vet centers and VA\-leased medical facilities. HCP include all VA licensed and unlicensed, clinical and administrative, remote and onsite, paid and without compensation, full\- and part\-time employees, intermittent employees, fee basis employees, VA contractors, researchers, volunteers and health professions trainees (HPTs) who are expected to perform any or all of their work at these facilities. HPTs may be paid or unpaid and include residents, interns, fellows and students. HCP also includes VHA personnel providing home\-based care to Veterans and drivers and other personnel whose duties put them in contact with patients outside VA medical facilities.
