jobs.title: Technical Recruiter
jobs.description:
**Job Summary:**

 

The Technical Recruiter will be responsible for collaborating with hiring managers to understand their needs, and sourcing candidates who bring value to the organization. The Technical Recruiter will also design recruitment strategies to meet the organization’s needs. This position also manages the college recruiting program (entry\-level rotational programs, interns and coops). Administers the entire employment process from developing the position, sourcing, screening, selecting, interviews, offer negotiation, background checks/drug screens, travel, relocation and on boarding.

 

 

**Responsibilities:**

 

* Consult with management and HR to identify staffing needs and workforce planning strategies, and develop recruitment plan to meet demands

* Develop position sourcing descriptions in consultation with business needs

* Leverage various resources to source qualified candidates, including internet recruiting resources, ATS, schools, networking, search firms, job fairs, media advertisements, employee referrals, etc.

* Screen candidates using resume screening, telephone screens, interviews, assessment tools, etc. as assigned

* Interview job applicants as part of the screening process to get information on their work history, job skills, training and education, and inform them of the positions duties and responsibilities, compensation, benefits and working conditions

* Select job applicants, confirm their qualifications and refer them to hiring managers, making recommendations when appropriate

* Coordinate interview process to best meet Toshibas needs (interview scheduling, travel, virtual interviews)Assist with the research and development of new sourcing methods and strategies

* Analyze employment data related to the position and create reports based on your findings

* Manage entry\-level rotational programs (e.g. Engineering) and coop/internship programs

* Contact applicants to inform them of their application statuses and conduct background or reference checks and drug screens on job applicants, particularly those who will be given job offers

* Manage relocation program in cost\-effective manner

* Manage all candidate correspondence (offers/declines/assessments/schedules)and on\-boarding processing

* Conduct new employee onboarding

* Co\-ordinate and facilitate recruitment functions, including job and career fairs, and college recruiting as required Manage and administer Application Tracking System

* Assist managers on hiring trends and recruitment tools / reporting metrics

* Ensure all documentation and filing is complete and current with regards to all state and federal guidelines

* Any other duties assigned by management

 

 

 

 

**Job Skills \& Qualifications:**

 

 

 

Required:

 

 

* Bachelor’s degree required.

* Minimum 3\-7 years of previous work experience in recruiting for positions in engineering, technical roles, operations, information technology or other related jobs

* Experience with sourcing passive candidates through LinkedIn and other avenues.

* Experience using social media

* Negotiation skills

* Excellent interpersonal communication skills

* Strong social aptitude and ability to build relationships

* Technical knowledge to be able to talk to job prospects and understand qualifications

 

 

Preferred:

 

 

* Degree coursework in business, human resources, information technology or an engineering\-technical field

* Experience with different behavioral style interviewing techniques Initiative, high energy, strong sense of urgency and the ability to handle many projects simultaneously.

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

* Ability to multi\-task Good organizational and problem solving skills

* Ability to establish positive and productive working\-recruiting relationships quickly and easily

* Proficiency in Microsoft Office programs, Word, Excel and PowerPoint, and prior experience with an Applicant Tracking System

 

 

Equal Opportunity Employer

 

This employer is required to notify all applicants of their rights pursuant to federal employment laws. For further information, please review the Know Your Rights notice from the Department of Labor.

jobs.title: Customer Experience Agent
jobs.description:
**Make a difference, protect lives, and achieve your dreams.** Build your career with the industry\-leading fire, life safety and security company.

 

**Summary:**

============

 

 

$21 \- $23 per hour

 

 

 

Establishes and maintains working relationships with external and internal customers with excellent communication via telephone, mail (postal or electronic), or in person. Provides administrative support to external and internal customers. This position is expected to handle phone traffic and a variety of administrative duties from 8:00am to 4:00pm.**Job Description:**

====================

 

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

 

* Performs a variety of clerical duties such as photocopying, scanning, faxing, filing, and data entry.

* Greets guests and employees in a professional, friendly, and hospitable manner.

* Professionally administers all incoming/outbound calls, redirects accordingly (i.e. leads to sales, service complaints to manager), and transfers to voicemail if unavailable.

* Consistently provides and maintains exemplary customer service for our customers to ensure retention.

* New customer leads passed directly to sales coordinator.

* Performs basic alarm technical troubleshooting.

* Understands Collection Policy and basic collection restrictions and adheres to the policy guidelines.

* Able to assist customers with Customer Portal needs.

* Provides callers with information such as company or branch addresses, directions to office locations, fax numbers, website, and other related information.

* Uses administrative skills to perform level I tasks in company software: Sedona, Stages, Office365, Outlook, OneNote, and various other Microsoft Office products.

* Accepts phone and EFT payments and processes in accounting software.

* Handles inbound billing questions and can pass the call appropriately if unable to resolve the issue.

* Enters credit requests to be approved by the office manager.

* Ability to work with technicians in the field to assist in investigating issues (site, panel, etc.)

* Ability to schedule service calls and alarm inspections.

* Ability to adjust technicians’ schedules and move appointments.

* Performs basic data entry in monitoring software (responsible party call list updates, password updates, and zones).

* Provides feedback to management regarding customer service breakdowns or customer concerns.

* Establishes and maintains working relationships with external and internal customers with excellent communication via telephone, mail (postal or electronic), or in person fostering harmonious interactions and relationships and maintain basic standards of civility in the workplace.

* Exemplifies our mission statement, Integrity, Initiative, and Intelligence.

* Adheres to the Code of Conduct, Confidentiality and Non\-Disclosure Agreement, and Company Safety Policy.

* Carries and displays Company ID and other pocket card licenses as required by jurisdiction, municipality, or customer.

* Ability to handle a great deal of stress over long periods of time.

* Employee will be responsible for working independently with direction from supervisor or manager.

 

**Other Duties**

 

* Performs other duties as assigned.

 

**Qualifications**

 

* High school diploma or G.E.D. equivalent.

* 2\-years related experience or training; or equivalent combination of education and experience. Excellent phone etiquette. Excellent verbal and

* written communication skills. Must read and speak English. Punctual with excellent attendance.

* Should be customer service driven.

* Able to multi\-task. Must be able to type proficiently and have working knowledge of Microsoft Word,

* Excel, Outlook, Instant Message, Office365, and OneNote. Competent in the ability to originate and correspond by email.

* Professional appearance, business casual. Must have good grooming and hygiene and must be free of excessive odors.

* Complies with all applicable safety, environment, health and waste management policies and procedures. U.S. Citizenship or permanent residency is required.

* Required to obtain \& maintain BSIS Alarm Company Employee License. Must successfully pass Livescan Background Check in accordance with CA State Regulations.

 

**Physical Demands**

 

 

Position involves prolonged sitting and keyboard use.

 

 

Occasionally may be required to lift and/or carry 15\-pound boxes from floor to table height. Repetitive motions such as answering phones, reaching, grasping, typing, sitting, standing, bending, etc. Failure to meet these requirements may result in the withdrawal of employment of other employment action.

 

**Training**

 

 

Must have knowledge of secretarial, office administrative procedures, and knowledge of use and operation of standard office equipment. Some analytical ability is required to gather and summarize data for reports, find solutions to various administrative problems, and prioritize work. Updates job knowledge by participating in educational opportunities and reading professional publications. Participates in virtual training with corporate trainers as required. Attends webinars or offsite

 

### **classes as assigned.**

 

**Decision Making**

 

 

Independent judgment is required to plan, prioritize, and organize diversified workload.

 

**Communication**

 

 

Excellent communication skills are required to work with all vendors, technicians, sales, and administration, as well as external and internal customers. Maintains customer confidence by keeping service and account information confidential.

 

**Benefits and Perks:**

=======================

 

* *Excellent pay*

* *Medical, dental, vision*

* *Company paid life insurance*

* *Company paid short term disability*

* *401K with employer match*

* *Paid vacation and company holidays*

* *Training and Career Development*

* *Company vehicle (if job applicable)*

 

*Pye\-Barker Fire and Safety is an Equal Opportunity Employer*

jobs.title: Freight Pay Analyst
jobs.description:
**Analyst Freight Pay**

 

 

**Who We Are:**

 

 

 

GEODIS specializes in unlocking business value in a complex world, ensuring seamless movement of goods worldwide. As a global third\-party logistics provider (3PL), we power *A Better Way to Deliver* for the world's top brands and manufacturers. Fuel your career with GEODIS and discover endless growth opportunities.

 

 

**Your role on the team:**

 

 

* Audits freight pay systems to include carrier freight bills

* Investigates and responds to carrier billing issues and carrier inquiries regarding payment of invoices/accounts

* Responds to internal and external customer inquiries on any issues relating to freight payment

* Manages carrier invoice aging reports

* Pulls data from multiple systems for analysis and manipulation

* Prepares and analyzes data including carrier invoices, TMS data and Great Plains data used to manage carrier payables

* Reviews and creates Excel reports to assist in the management of the FAP process

* Prepares and analyzes data including carrier invoices, TMS data and Great Plains data used to manage carrier payables

* Performs clerical work as required, including answering phone calls, managing mail, operating various office machines and computers, sorting, filing, corresponding with internal and external employee and carrier representatives

 

 

**What you need:**

 

 

* Minimum 1\-year related experience and/or training; or an equivalent combination of education and experience

* Experience and high proficiency in Excel

* Experience in customer service and the transportation industry, such as rate entry, collection, billing and/or operations preferred

* Knowledge of TMS applications and Great Plains systems preferred

* PC literate to include Microsoft Office products such as Word and Outlook

* Ability to read, analyze and interpret freight payment procedures and carrier pricing contracts

* Ability to write reports and business correspondence and maintain business procedure documentation

jobs.title: Fitness Program Manager
jobs.description:
HealthFitness, a Trustmark company, is a proven leader in providing fitness solutions that engage and connect people both on\-site and online, to create a strong community of health. Our work focuses on creating meaningful connections with each of our participants to help them move forward. We foster each individual’s journey by creating communities of health within the organizations we serve – so that everyone is supported. As an employee of HealthFitness you will enjoy a variety of health and financial benefits and receive competitive pay. We provide personal and professional support, training and development and flexible employment opportunities.

HealthFitness has an exciting new opportunity for a full\-time (36 hrs/wk) entry\-level Fitness Program Manager at our client site located in Washington, DC. In this role, you will manage and direct all operational aspects of two small, single client on\-site fitness program ensuring the highest level of participation, results achievement, and customer satisfaction in the delivery of onsite and virtual programs and services. You will be responsible for contract compliance; development of and adherence to the strategic business plan; design and facilitation of a variety of health and fitness programs; and various administrative duties including developing outcomes focused management reports. You will also implement and instruct individual and group fitness programs, provide floor supervision, fitness testing, exercise prescriptions, and orientations.

Responsible for managing and directing all operational aspects of an on\-site fitness program ensuring the highest level of participation, results achievement, and customer satisfaction in the delivery of programs and services. Also responsible for contract compliance; development of and adherence to the strategic business plan; staff supervision, training, and development; design and facilitation of a variety of health \&fitness programs; and various administrative duties including developing outcomes focused management reports.

Key Accountabilities* Manages all program activities in accordance with HealthFitness operational, quality, safety, and service standards.

* Develops and implements the yearly strategic business plan to identify contract deliverables, program/ service offerings and initiatives, targeted outcomes, and marketing strategy to meet client objectives. Prepares and manages operating budget. Ensures expenditures are made in accordance with applicable policies and procedures.

* May leads regular individual and group staff meetings to ensure associates are informed about HealthFitness, client and program events, initiatives, and status.

* Ensures contract compliance. Manages client relationship to ensure that high customer satisfaction is maintained and HealthFitness value is reinforced.

* Directs the implementation of individual and group fitness programs, health education activities, motivational programs, and special events; coordinates marketing and communications to maximize program engagement, bringing in HealthFitness Corporate support as appropriate.

* Tracks participant and program data for measurement of individual and program goal achievement, outcomes, and results; creates outcomes focused management reports based on the identified business plan goals and objectives. Manages all record and data management activities at the worksite, ensuring the proper storage, retention, and confidentiality all data collected in accordance with HealthFitness requirements.

* Conducts informal safety checks daily and performs routine safety audits on a weekly, monthly, and quarterly basis in accordance with HealthFitness guidelines.

* Performs staff responsibilities as appropriate including floor supervision, fitness testing, exercise prescription, new member facility and equipment orientations, personal training, and group exercise class instruction. Verifies equipment is well maintained and operating properly; ensures locker rooms are clean and stocked, and coordinates prompt resolution to facility related issues.

* In conjunction with Director CS, introduces new HealthFitness programs, products, and services to the client.

* Other duties as needed/assigned.

 

 

 

Minimum Requirements* Associates Degree or higher in Exercise Science, Health Promotion, Kinesiology or related discipline and 1\+ years related experience or equivalent combination of education, certifications, and experience.

* Current Adult CPR/AED/First Aid certifications from American Heart Association, American Red Cross, National Safety Institute, or American Safety \& Health Institute required by start date. (Note: certification must have an in\-person component and not 100% online/OSHA compliant).

* Group Exercise Instructor or Personal Trainer certification from a HealthFitness approved NCCA accredited program. (if not, current one will be required within 30 days).

* Demonstrated experience in leading, coordinating and delivering effective programs including budgeting, marketing, and promotions.

* Ability to effectively organize and prioritize work demands.

* Strong interpersonal communication and customer service skills including the ability to motivate others.

* Computer proficiency in Microsoft Office programs including at minimum Word, Excel, and Outlook.

* Ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a team with enthusiasm, initiative, and creativity.

* Proficiency in fitness assessment and exercise prescription if applicable.

 

 

Compensation: $35,500/Year \- $39,500/Year. Pay is dependent on experience and qualifications. Additional commission opportunities for someone with an industry recognized and HealthFitness approved Personal Trainer certification.

Brand: HealthFitness

Come join HealthFitness! Join a team that will not only utilize your current skills but will enhance them as well. We offer a comprehensive benefit package that includes Medical/Dental/Vision plans including HSA and FSA options, retirement/401(k) with employer matching program, certification reimbursement program, paid new parent leave, paid Holidays and PTO (starting at 3 weeks for full\-time associates), volunteer paid time off and much more.

HealthFitness is committed to leveraging the talent of a diverse workforce to create great opportunities for our people and our business. We are an equal opportunity employer, including disability and protected veteran status.

jobs.title: Administrative Professional 1 - 20024921
jobs.description:
**What You’ll Do:**

 

 

* Types, proofreads, and edits typed documents

* Copies, scans, distributes, posts and/or files correspondences, reports, and memos

* Prepares various documents (e.g., composes, types, obtains signatures)

* Performs routine administrative duties (e. g., composes and responds to routine correspondence and verbal requests not requiring the personal attention of supervisor)

* Produces typed copy of staff correspondence, schedules, logs kites and types responses

* Researches, retrieves, and enters data into DOTS Portal system or other applicable programs

* Directs telephone inquiries from the public to the appropriate staff member

* Inputs data entry into ORAS, as needed

* Maintains and provides applicable documentation as required by American Correctional Association Standards, Ohio Department of Rehabilitation and Correction Administrative Regulations, policies and/or procedures.

* Interacts with other departments

* Provides information and compilation of data

* Receives, sorts, reviews, and distributes all incoming/outgoing mail, correspondence, and directives

* Schedules and provides clerical support for appointments/meetings (e.g., special projects and, for unit administrative professional 1’s, video in\-reach, virtual hearings and virtual funeral visits)

* Performs general clerical tasks (e.g., answers telephones, files, orders supplies, inventory control, copies documents and files, maintains calendars and itineraries)

* Reviews visiting applications for completion of content and enters data into DOTS Portal System.

* Coordinates and ensures processing of routine tasks

* Sets up and maintains (e.g., organizes, alphabetizes and files) correspondences, forms, and reports

* Creates new files

* Purges records in accordance with applicable retention schedules

* Manages appointment schedules, notifies appropriate personnel of schedules, makes arrangements for meetings and provides clerical support to other offices, as assigned.

* Serves on committees and attends meetings, seminars, conferences, and in\- service training as required

* Ensures work area is secure, clean, and orderly

* Provides other related clerical support as required

* Performs other duties as assigned.

 

**Why Work for the State of Ohio**

At the State of Ohio, we take care of the team that cares for Ohioans. We provide a variety of quality, competitive benefits to eligible full\-time and part\-time employees\*. For a list of all the State of Ohio Benefits, visit our Total Rewards website! Our benefits package includes:

 

 

* Medical Coverage

* Free Dental, Vision and Basic Life Insurance premiums after completion of eligibility period

* Paid time off, including vacation, personal, sick leave and 11 paid holidays per year

* Childbirth, Adoption, and Foster Care leave

* Education and Development Opportunities (Employee Development Funds, Public Service Loan Forgiveness, and more)

* Public Retirement Systems (such as OPERS, STRS, SERS, and HPRS) \& Optional Deferred Compensation (Ohio Deferred Compensation)

 

 

* Benefits eligibility is dependent on a number of factors. The Agency Contact listed above will be able to provide specific benefits information for this position.

 

**Qualifications**

1 yr. trg. or 1 yr. exp. in secretarial science or business office applications. For positions requiring technical terminology, applicants must also have 6 mos. trg. or 6 mos. exp. in relevant technical terminology.

 

 

 

 

* Or equivalent of Minimum Class Qualifications For Employment noted above

 

 

 

**Job Skills:** Administrative Support/Services, Computer Literacy, Clerical \& Data Entry, Attention to Detail, Organizing and Planning, Time Management**Supplemental Information****Application Procedures:**

 

In order to be considered for this position, you must apply on\-line through this posting website. (We no longer accept paper applications.)

 

 

* When completing your on\-line Ohio Civil Service Application, be sure to clearly describe how you meet the minimum qualifications outlined on this job posting.

* We cannot give you credit for your qualifications, experience, education and training in the job selection process if you do not provide it in your on\-line application.

* You can check the status of your application by signing into your profile on this website.

* We will communicate with you through the email you provided in your profile and job application. Be sure to check your email often.

 

If you require a reasonable accommodation for the application process, please contact the Human Resources Office so proper arrangements can be made. Otherwise, you will be given specific instructions on requesting an accommodation if you are invited to an assessment and/or interview.

 

 

The Ohio Department of Rehabilitation and Correction is a tobacco\-free workplace.

 

 

**Pre\-Employment Drug Testing:**

 

All final applicants tentatively selected for this position will be required to submit to urinalysis to test for illegal drug use prior to appointments. Testing will also be performed for the presence of marijuana. An applicant with a positive test shall not be offered employment unless the applicant submits medical documentation of legally prescribed medications or a recommendation for medical marijuana.

 

 

**Pre\-Employment Background Investigation:**

 

The final applicant selected for the position will be required to undergo a criminal background check. An individual assessment of an applicant’s prior criminal convictions will be made before excluding an applicant from consideration.

 

The Ohio Department of Rehabilitation and Correction is prohibited from hiring:

 

 

 

* Individuals under a federal or state weapons disability if the position requires firearms certification/recertification and use;

* Individuals who have engaged in sexual abuse in a prison or other confinement facility; have been civilly or administratively adjudicated, or convicted of engaging or attempting to engage in sexual activity in the community facilitated by force, implied threats of force, or if the victim did not or was unable to consent;

* Individuals convicted of soliciting or providing support for an act of terrorism, terrorism, or money laundering to support terrorism;

* Individuals who have been convicted of or pled guilty to a felony where a direct correlation exists between the position and prior criminal behavior.

 

**ADA Statement**

Ohio is a Disability Inclusion State and strives to be a model employer of individuals with disabilities. The State of Ohio is committed to providing access and inclusion and reasonable accommodation in its services, activities, programs and employment opportunities in accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) and other applicable laws.

 

**Drug\-Free Workplace**

The State of Ohio is a drug\-free workplace which prohibits the use of marijuana (recreational marijuana/non\-medical cannabis). Please note, this position may be subject to additional restrictions pursuant to the State of Ohio Drug\-Free Workplace Policy (HR\-39\), and as outlined in the posting.

jobs.title: Service Assurance Associate – Bilingual Spanish/English
jobs.description:
Service Assurance Associate – Bilingual Spanish/English

 

Job Description

 

CoStar Group (NASDAQ: CSGP) is a leading global provider of commercial and residential real estate information, analytics, and online marketplaces. Included in the S\&P 500 Index and the NASDAQ 100, CoStar Group is on a mission to digitize the world’s real estate, empowering all people to discover properties, insights and connections that improve their businesses and lives.

We have been living and breathing the world of real estate information and online marketplaces for over 35 years, giving us the perspective to create truly unique and valuable offerings to our customers. We’ve continually refined, transformed and perfected our approach to our business, creating a language that has become standard in our industry, for our customers, and even our competitors. We continue that effort today and are always working to improve and drive innovation. This is how we deliver for our customers, our employees, and investors. By equipping the brightest minds with the best resources available, we provide an invaluable edge in real estate.

The Service Assurance Associate is responsible for measuring activity and assessing the quality of service delivered by any representative from CoStar Group. In this role, you proactively call customers, actively listen, and remain unbiased as you accurately capture their feedback. In addition, you inspect and audit the quality of interaction data entry.

This position is in office Monday through Friday.

RESPONSIBILITIES* Complete Service Score Surveys, via outbound calling, with customers/potential customers within seven business days or less of a meeting or phone interaction with any representative from CoStar Group. Approximately 200\+ outbound calls per day.

* Execute professionalism via all telephone interactions including effective questioning, listening, and probing.

* Maintain objectivity while soliciting feedback on the quality of service.

* Assess the quality of data of any representative from CoStar Group.

* Record accurately and timely all results from surveys and data reviews.

* Timely reporting of escalations to Management.

* Communicate with internal departments to resolve customer concerns and follow\-up on resolution with customer when necessary.

* Provide timely feedback to CoStar Group representatives based on customer feedback and review of data entry.

* Maintain the highest professional standards and promote our ethics of trust, open communication, creative thinking and cohesive team effort.

 

 

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS* Bachelor's Degree required from an accredited, not for profit University or College

* Bilingual Spanish/English required (written and verbal)

* A proven track record of commitment to prior employers

* Experience using Enterprise and/or CRM system

* Minimum of 1 year experience interacting with customers

* Minimum of 1 year experience of executing high call volume with high levels of data accuracy

* Proficiency in MS Office, including Excel, PowerPoint, Word and Outlook

* Proven ability of performing to metrics/key performance indicators

* Experience building rapport over the telephone and overcoming objections in a professional environment

* Experience of delivering results whilst working to deadlines under pressure

* Experience of accurately capturing and entering data

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills

 

 

PREFERRED QUALIFCATIONS AND SKILLS* Enterprise knowledge and experience strongly preferred

* High level of proficiency with CoStar Products preferred

* Proficiency with internal systems and the ability to quickly learn new applications

* Ability to plan and prioritize workload in a fast\-paced environment

* Ability to act on own initiative and work successfully alone and as part of a team

* Ability to adapt quickly in a technology led environment

* Confident personality with the ability to communicate effectively and professionally with both internal and external stakeholders

 

 

What’s in it for you?

When you join CoStar Group, you’ll experience a collaborative and innovative culture working alongside the best and brightest to empower our people and customers to succeed.

We offer you generous compensation and performance\-based incentives. CoStar Group also invests in your professional and academic growth with internal training, tuition reimbursement, and an inter\-office exchange program.

Our benefits package includes (but not limited to):* Comprehensive healthcare coverage: Medical / Vision / Dental / Prescription Drug

* Life, legal, and supplementary insurance

* Virtual and in person mental health counseling services for individuals and family

* Commuter and parking benefits

* 401(K) retirement plan with matching contributions

* Employee stock purchase plan

* Paid time off

* Tuition reimbursement

* On\-site fitness center and/or reimbursed fitness center membership costs (location dependent), with yoga studio, Pelotons, personal training, group exercise classes

* Access to CoStar Group’s Diversity, Equity, \& Inclusion Employee Resource Groups

 

 

We welcome all qualified candidates who are currently eligible to work full\-time in the United States to apply. However, please note that CoStar Group is not able to provide visa sponsorship for this position.

CoStar Group is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer; we maintain a drug\-free workplace and perform pre\-employment substance abuse testing

jobs.title: Manufacturing Technical Training II/Senior
jobs.description:
At KBI Biopharma, we are advancing science and accelerating breakthroughs. As a global leader in biopharmaceutical development and manufacturing, we empower life science companies to bring new medicines and vaccines to the world faster. Explore your potential at KBI, where innovation meets impact.

Position Summary:

The Manufacturing Technical Training Specialist is a member of the manufacturing group for a Contract Development \& Manufacturing Organization (CDMO) performing research, process development and GMP manufacture of mammalian cell culture bulk drug substance. The core responsibility of the Manufacturing Technical Training Specialist is to manage all aspects of the technical training program for the GMP manufacturing team at the Durham manufacturing facility. The individual will work with manufacturing management to develop and manage the hands\-on training curriculums, technical training plans, and training documentation for the manufacturing staff. Additionally, the individual will be responsible for developing OJTs, ILCs and technical training content, creating and revising task training documentation, and performing on the job training for manufacturing equipment in upstream, downstream, and support services. The Technical Training Specialist is also responsible for developing and providing training presentations with subject matter experts on relevant topics, working with Manufacturing Management to develop curricula, providing measures to ensure complete understanding/proficiency, and providing CAPA support stemming from investigations. Other training related materials and responsibilities will be assigned per the discretion of the head of manufacturing.

Responsibilities:

Technical Training Specialist II:* Lead or assist in the development of classroom (virtual and in\-person) training, computer\-based training, and On the Job (OJT) training programs based on user requirements

* Facilitate classroom training including new employee orientation, annual cGMP training, and programs for supported quality systems

* Assist with the administration of the Learning Management System (LMS) \& perform data entry in LMS

* Provide support for training inquiries and projects

* Facilitate projects and training initiatives that drive quality, compliance, and operational effectiveness for the organization

* Manage end\-to\-end delivery of training to the identified learner group (i.e., scheduling, communications, tracking, and reporting training completion). Schedule in\-person and virtual instructor\-led training sessions; organize course logistics (invites, room bookings, etc.) for training programs

* Other duties as assigned

 

 

Technical Training Sr. Specialist:* Lead or assist in the development of classroom (virtual and in\-person) training, computer\-based training, and On the Job (OJT) training programs based on user requirements

* Facilitate classroom training including new employee orientation, annual cGMP training, and programs for supported quality systems

* Assist with the administration of the Learning Management System (LMS) \& perform data entry in LMS

* Provide support for training inquiries and projects

* Facilitate projects and training initiatives that drive quality, compliance, and operational effectiveness for the organization

* Manage end\-to\-end delivery of training to the identified learner group (i.e., scheduling, communications, tracking, and reporting training completion). Schedule in\-person and virtual instructor\-led training sessions; organize course logistics (invites, room bookings, etc.) for training programs

* Other duties as assigned

 

 

Requirements:* Technical Training Specialist II: B.A./B.S. in a Life Sciences discipline and 5\+ years or equivalent experience with a high school degree.

* Senior Specialist: BA/BS and 7\+ years’ experience or MS and 5\+ years’ experience in a QA or GMP environment or equivalent. Pharmaceutical, biopharmaceutical, or medical device industry experience required. Experience in a Training role is required.

* Must possess knowledge or experience in Upstream process including bioreactor or fermentor and/or Downstream process including AKTA, Chromatography, and column packing.

* Experience in SAP or related inventory system

* Proficiency in MODA\-ES system

* Experience within the biologic, pharmaceutical or medical device industry with responsibilities for performing and/or developing or delivering training to colleagues

* Proficiency with electronic systems, including Power Point, Microsoft WORDS and Excel, Compliance Wire, EtQ, and other enterprise systems

* Must be effective in presentation skills

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills

* Have the knowledge, and ability to apply basic scientific and regulatory principles utilized to solve operational, as well as routine Manufacturing operations

* Possesses the knowledge of adult learning theory, training delivery and how to meet the needs of the learner is ideal

* The individual may be required to perform training and interact with staff who work nights and may be required to work off normal business hours to support manufacturing staff. The expected shift will be from Monday\-Friday 2pm\-11pm.

 

 

Salary Range:* Technical Training Specialist II\- $94,500 \- $126,000

* Technical Training Sr Specialist\- $113,400 \- $151,000

 

 

Salary range provided per current averages and expectations. The salary and job title for this opening will be based on the selected candidate’s qualifications and experience and may be outside this range. KBI has a robust total rewards strategy which includes an annual bonus structure for all employees, medical, dental, and vision coverage, paid PTO and holidays, 401K matching with 100% vesting in 60 days and employee recognition programs.

KBI Biopharma, Inc., a JSR Life Sciences company, is a global contract development and manufacturing organization (CDMO) providing fully integrated and accelerated drug development and biologics manufacturing services to life science companies. KBI supports its 500\+ customers in advancing more than 160 drug candidates from preclinical and clinical stages to market, including the manufacture of ten commercial products. Recognized for quality manufacturing, KBI delivers robust process development and cGMP manufacturing services across its six global locations in the USA and Europe. For more information, visit www.kbibiopharma.com.

jobs.title: Sales Representative
jobs.description:
**The Right Company. The Right Industry. The Right Time.**

 

 

 

Looking to break into sales? Or maybe you’ve already got some experience under your belt? Either way, we want to meet you!

 

 

 

Imagine going back in time and selling iPhones when everyone still had flip phones. You’d kill it, right? Well, that’s exactly what’s happening in the fiber industry right now. This market is on fire, everyone wants faster, better internet, and fiber is the best of the best! No more trying to convince people to buy something they don’t need or want. This product practically sells itself!

 

 

 

At Clearly, we’ve partnered with fiber companies across the U.S., and thanks to huge market demand, we’re growing faster than ever, and we need awesome people to join our team! We’re on the hunt for a few entry\-level Sales Reps who we can train into total pros and develop for leadership. You’ll get a simple, proven process to follow — no guesswork, no complicated systems.

 

 

 

Our reps go Door 2 Door straight to the customer. No messy pipelines. No endless waiting for commissions.

 

 

 

Speaking of commissions — they’re BIG. Our average reps are pulling in over $2,000 a week!

 

*Heads up — this is a 100% commission role.* But if you’re hungry and ready to hustle, you can make serious money.

 

**Compensation:**

$50,000 \- $100,000 yearly

 

**Responsibilities:*** Going door 2 door in assigned territories and explaining what fiber internet is to the people in the community

* Collecting basic info (name, phone number, and email) and scheduling installation dates for fiber internet

* Tracking interactions at each door using our app to maintain accurate data on your assigned turf

* Attending weekly in\-office trainings as well as daily virtual trainings

 

**Qualifications:*** Genuine love for meeting new people!

* Strong interpersonal communication skills

* Ability to always bring a positive attitude to the workplace

* 18 years or older

* Ability to work on your feet for extended periods of time

* Reliable transportation to get to and from field and weekly trainings

 

**About Company**

 

At Clearly, **our \#1 focus is you**. We're all about helping people grow, unlock their true potential, and realize they’re capable of making life\-changing money.

 

 

Too often, society writes off people who don’t have fancy degrees or niche industry experience. Not here. At Clearly, we welcome those people — and prove to them that they’re capable of so much more than the box the world tries to put them in.

jobs.title: Licensed Trauma Psychotherapist
jobs.description:
**Are you a Licensed Psychotherapist (LMFT, LMSW, LPC) EMDR trained, passionate about helping clients heal from trauma—without the burnout of insurance billing or endless admin tasks?**

 

**Position Overview:** The **Licensed Psychotherapist (LMFT, LMSW, LPC)** will provide psychotherapy services to clients of Trauma Healing Therapy (THT). Clinical therapy services will include **treatment individuals, couples /families at this time.** We are currently looking for a **full\-time Licensed Psychotherapist (LMFT, LMSW, LPC)** in the State of **California** who is ready to be a part of a dynamic, kind, growing, and collaborative team. This position is **in person** in our Cupertino office location.

 

**Reports to:** Dr. Mariella Lauriola, PhD

 

**About THT:** At THT, it is our mission to help clients and the community heal from trauma and relationship wounds using two simple ingredients: evidence\-based clinical techniques AND an empathic, warm, humanistic approach to psychotherapy.

 

**Some Essential Functions and Responsibilities**

 

* Schedule appointments with clients **(individuals, couples /families )** and provide in\-person clinical counseling services to clients of Trauma Healing Therapy in accordance with company policies. Experience working with minors is a plus!

* Flexible schedule, preferably the candidate has the ability to work some evening shifts (4–8 PM PT) and one weekend day (Sat or Sun).

* Respond to clients’ requests for services or calls within 24\-36 hours during scheduled shifts, whether such requests are made via email, phone, voicemail, or through the THT website.

* Communicate with a client’s treatment team (e.g., primary care provider, psychiatrist) as necessary.

* Complete written records for each client, including intake notes, progress notes, treatment plans, termination notes, and other required documents, within 24\-48 hours of rendered therapy services.

* Maintain accurate and up\-to\-date client files.

* Attend mandatory weekly staff meetings, monthly meetings with Dr. Mariella Lauriola, and any required work\-related training.

* Run psychoeducational workshops in the community or psychotherapy groups as needed.

* Adhere to all practice and professional procedures

 

**Minimum Requirements:**

 

* Must be in alignment with THT’s mission, vision, and values.

* **Master degree (LMFT, LMSW, LPC)** in psychology or a related field.

* **Active, unrestricted license as a psychotherapist (LMFT, LMSW, LPC)** in the State of California. A copy of the license must be provided to THT, and the license must remain active throughout employment. Immediate notification to THT is required if the license is suspended, restricted, revoked, or canceled.

* **At least 2 years of licensed experience** providing psychotherapy services (preferred in private practice settings). Candidates with less experience will be considered only if fully licensed and with a strong clinical background.

* **Trauma training is** ***required*** (highly preferred EMDR training, but other trauma training are also acceptable ie. brain\-spotting, TF\-CBT etc) . Candidates with training on couples/family therapy modalities are also strongly encouraged to apply (i.e., EFT, Gottman Method).

* Adherence to all laws, rules, regulations, and ethical codes governing psychological practice in California.

* Reliable attendance, timely arrival, and commitment to maintaining a minimum **weekly caseload of 25 clients** .

* Superior verbal and written communication skills.

* Compassionate demeanor, strong work ethic, and ability to provide professional counseling services aligned with THT’s mission.

* Proficiency in EHR, Google Workspace, and video conferencing platforms.

* Attention to detail is a must

 

**What We Offer (besides warm vibes):**

 

* **Competitive compensation**

* **Paid admin hours**

* **Full office support**

* **Paid HIPAA compliant AI note taker for client sessions**

* **Paid malpractice insurance**

* **Just therapy, no marketing stress**

* **Flexible unpaid vacation time**

* **Paid sick leave**

* **CalSavers retirement plan**

* **Room to grow**

 

**This position is perfect for you if you’re:**

 

* Aligned with THT mission, vision, and values.

* Energized by helping others in a team and contributing to THT’s growth.

* Creative, engaged in meaningful work, and excited about our mission.

* Open to kind, constructive feedback and able to integrate it into practice.

* Looking forward to growing within and with THT.

 

**Application Instructions:**For consideration, please email your full CV with references to info@traumahealingtherapy.com with the subject line **“THT Licensed Psychotherapist Application (child/teen/family focus).”**

 

Job Type: Full\-time

 

Pay: $100\.00 \- $120\.00 per hour

 

Schedule:

 

* Choose your own hours

* Monday to Friday

* On call

jobs.title: Legal Operations Manager
jobs.description:
**Company Description**

 

Since opening our first self\-storage facility in 1972, **Public Storage** has grown to become the **largest owner and operator of self\-storage facilities** in the world. With **thousands of locations** across the U.S. and Europe, and more than 170 million net rentable square feet of real estate, we're also one of the largest landlords.

 

 

We've been recognized as **A Great Place to Work** by the Great Place to Work Institute. And, our employees have also voted us as having **Best Career Growth**, ranked us in the **Top 5% for Work Culture**, and in the **Top 10% for Diversity and Inclusion**.

 

 

We're a member of the **S\&P 500** and **FT Global 500**. Our common and preferred stocks trade on the New York Stock Exchange.

 

**Job Description** **Position Summary:** The Legal Operations Manager is responsible for partnering directly with the Chief Legal Officer to optimize the Legal Department’s processes, technology, and workflows. This position sits at the intersection of legal, business, and technology and will focus on financial reporting, enhanced productivity, cost management, strategic planning, and process improvement within the Legal Department.

 

**Key Responsibilities**

 

* **Departmental Strategy, Project Management, and Process Optimization:**

+ Collaborate with the Chief Legal Officer on developing, implementing, and tracking and reporting on progress against strategic initiatives.

+ Develop and enhance internal workflow processes, knowledge management, and best practices across the legal team.

+ Identify opportunities for automation and continuous improvement.

* **Technology \& Tools:**

+ Manage and optimize legal technologies and platforms (e.g., CounselLink, SharePoint, ServiceNow).

+ Provide training and support for legal department personnel on matter management tools.

+ Recommend and implement new legal technology solutions to increase efficiency.

* **Financial and Vendor Management:**

+ Oversee Legal Department budgeting, accruals, and spend tracking.

+ Manage onboarding of new law firms, review compliance with billing guidelines, and negotiate rates.

+ Partner with outside counsel and vendors to monitor billing protocols and drive cost\-saving initiatives.

+ Oversee setup of vendors and ensure timely payment and tracking of vendor invoices, settlement payments, and other payables. Resolve invoice payment and reconciliation issues, coordinating with internal and external teams.

+ Facilitate RFPs, vendor selection, and contract management for legal services.

* **Reporting \& Analytics:**

+ Develop and deliver regular reports, dashboards, and metrics to drive informed legal and business decisions.

+ Ensure accurate monthly accruals and reconcile financial reports.

* **Litigation \& Administrative Support:**

+ Supervise and delegate responsibilities to Legal Operations Admin.

+ Oversee arbitration opt\-out processes, cash receipt reconciliations, service of process tracking, and membership renewals for in\-house counsel.

+ Support Chief Legal Officer in litigation management and administrative tasks.

+ Manage small claims cases, prepare subpoena responses, and support processing of legal correspondence and service of process.

+ Assign matters to outside counsel and other vendors as appropriate.

 

 

 

**Qualifications**

 

* Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Finance, or a related field

* 5\+ years of experience in legal operations, law firm administration, or in\-house legal department management.

* Strong financial reporting and budget management skills.

* Expertise in legal spend, matter management, and other technology platforms (e.g., CounselLink Service Now); proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite.

* Understanding of legal processes in a corporate environment; prior public company and/or real estate sector experience a strong plus.

* Superior organizational, analytical, project management, and communication skills.

* High degree of professionalism, discretion, and integrity.

* Demonstrated ability to build cross\-functional relationships and influence at all levels.

* Proven ability to manage and train a direct report.

 

 

This role is ideal for a highly organized professional who thrives on improving legal department operations while managing financial and administrative processes effectively.

 

**Additional Information** **Compensation**

 

**Base Pay Range**: $155,000 \- $180,000

 

 

Compensation may vary outside of this range depending on a number of factors, including a candidate’s qualifications, skills, competencies and experience, and location. Base pay is one part of our total awards approach to compensation which is provided to compensate and recognize employees for their work, and this role may be eligible for additional discretionary bonuses or incentives.

 

**Workplace**

 

* One of our values pillars is to work as OneTeam and we believe that there is no replacement for in\-person collaboration but understand the value of some flexibility. Public Storage teammates are expected to work in the office five days each week with the option to take up to three flexible remote days per month.

+ Our office is located in west Glendale, near Interstate 5 and Western, just south of downtown Burbank

 

 

Public Storage is an equal opportunity employer and embraces diversity. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, or any other protected status. All qualified candidates are encouraged to apply.

 

 

 

REF3156I

jobs.title: Fully Licensed Mental Health Therapist - (PhD, Psy.D., LCSW, LPC, LMFT, LMHC) - Virginia
jobs.description:
**Summary:**

 

We are looking to bring on FIVE remote, telehealth clinicians **(that need to be fully licensed in the state of Virginia)** to our counseling and sleep practice. We have a waitlist of clients and are looking to fill our roles **as soon as possible**.

 

You do not need any sleep experience to apply to this role\-\-all the training and mentorship you need will be provided to you. However, you do need to hold a full license as a mental health clinician (e.g., Licensed clinical psychologists, LCSW, LPC, LMFT, LMHC, PhD, PsyD...etc.). **At this time we are not hiring provisionally licensed clinicians or those who require supervision.**

 

**This position provides complete admin support**—we take care of your insurance credentialing, finding patients for you, scheduling patients, and handling billing—allowing you to dedicate your efforts to what you excel at: providing therapeutic care to patients.

 

We are hiring for 1099 (flexible hours/contractor) and W2 (full\-time) roles. **We typically recommend starting with a 1099 (independent contractor) arrangement**. Once you’ve seen at least 15 clients and are familiar with behavioral sleep medicine and our clinic’s processes, it may be a good time to consider transitioning to W\-2 (employee) status. That transition generally takes place within 3–6 months, assuming everything progresses smoothly.

 

**About the practice:**

 

We’re a practice dedicated to both sleep and mental health, with a **primary clinical emphasis on insomnia and sleep\-related concerns**. While our core expertise lies in behavioral sleep medicine, we **also provide general counseling and psychotherapy** to support the broader mental health needs of our clients. Our goal is to create meaningful, sustainable careers for mental health professionals in a growing and highly sought\-after specialty—while also offering the flexibility to engage in general counseling work. Through this balanced approach, we aim to provide comprehensive, compassionate care that addresses both sleep and emotional well\-being.

 

We believe in the strong connection between a good night's sleep and mental well\-being, and work to provide care that looks at both. Our team is made up of dedicated therapists and psychologists who create a friendly place to work, where we care as much about the health of our patients as we do about the happiness and well\-being of our clinicians.

 

Please note: **we only offer therapy sessions to clients who are 18 years old or older**. Therefore, applicants must have prior experience delivering one\-on\-one counseling to adult individuals.

 

**Responsibilities:**

 

* Conduct telehealth therapy sessions with our clients (typically 53 minutes long).

* Undergo training to remain current with advancements in sleep therapy (prior experience in sleep therapy is not required for this role).

* Keep accurate records of case notes and track the progress of clients.

* Use our EHR to look at a client's sleep data and use it to inform your therapy / care.

 

**Reasons to join our team:**

 

* **Join a team that care as much about our clinicians as we do our clients.** We'll treat you as a first class citizen, giving you as much support as you need, fill your caseload, and give you an industry\-leading fee split (70% fee split)

* **Learn a valuable new skillset** that goes beyond what a normal therapy practice can teach you.

* Work where you're respected and supported, in a place that lets you **adjust your schedule to fit your life**.

* Say goodbye to the headache of paperwork and missed appointments. **We handle all the admin stuff** like scheduling, billing, credentialing, copay collection, no\-show fees...etc. for you. Anything that's not delivering therapy to clients, you let us know and we'll take care of it!

* Feel secure in **a job that's here to stay and support you**. We are in this for the long\-term.

 

**A typical client:**

 

When you join our team, you'll find that a lot of our clients are struggling with chronic insomnia, often rooted in psychological issues like anxiety or stress from work. We usually set up weekly sessions, each lasting about 53 minutes, and the first 8\-10 weeks are dedicated to sleep\-focused therapy (e.g., CBT for Insomnia) following a semi\-structured protocol.

 

During these weeks, we'll also really get to the heart of what's causing their sleep issues. Either during or after the first 8\-10 weeks we'll start to delve into the underlying psychological factors (such as anxiety, stress, depression) and then continue to help our clients manage those underlying factors over the long run.

 

Looking forward to possibly working together and making a difference!

 

Job Types: Full\-time, Part\-time, Contract

 

Pay: $70\.00 \- $110\.00 per hour

 

Expected hours: No less than 15 per week

 

Schedule:

 

* Choose your own hours

 

Application Question(s):

 

* Do you have experience counseling 1:1 with adult clients?

* When would you be available to start?

* What’s your general weekly availability (in hours)?

* How long do you see yourself being able to commit to this role?

* Do you anticipate any changes to your availability over the next 12 months?

* What are your primary areas of focus or interest in mental health?

* Can you provide your mental health license number and what states you are licensed in?

* Which payers have you been credentialed with?

 

Experience:

 

* Private practice: 2 years (Preferred)

* Telehealth: 2 years (Preferred)

* Cognitive behavioral therapy: 2 years (Preferred)

* cognitive behavioral therapy for insomnia (CBTI): 1 year (Preferred)

 

Work Location: Remote

Therefore, applicants must have prior experience delivering one\-on\-one counseling to adult individuals.   **Responsibilities:**   * Conduct telehealth therapy sessions with our clients (typically 53 minutes long). * Undergo training to remain current with advancements in sleep therapy (prior experience in sleep therapy is not required for this role). * Keep accurate records of case notes and track the progress of clients. * Use our EHR to look at a client's sleep data and use it to inform your care.   **Reasons to join our team:**   * **Join a team that care as much about our clinicians as we do our clients.** We'll treat you as a first class citizen, giving you as much support as you need, fill your caseload, and give you an industry\-leading fee split (70% fee split) * **Learn a valuable new skillset** that goes beyond what a normal therapy practice can teach you. There’s an overwhelming amount of demand for chronic insomnia treatment (30 million Americans suffer from it) * Say goodbye to the headache of paperwork and missed appointments. **We handle all the admin stuff** like scheduling, billing, credentialing, copay collection, no\-show fees...etc. for you. Anything that's not delivering therapy to clients, you let us know and we'll take care of it! * Feel secure in **a job that's here to stay and support you**. We are in this for the long\-term. * Work where you're respected and supported, in a place that lets you **adjust your schedule to fit your life**.   **A typical client:**   When you join our team, you'll find that a lot of our clients are struggling with chronic insomnia, often rooted in psychological issues like anxiety or stress from work. We usually set up weekly sessions, each lasting about 53 minutes, and the first 8\-10 weeks are dedicated to sleep\-focused therapy (e.g., CBT for Insomnia) following a semi\-structured protocol.   During these weeks, we'll also really get to the heart of what's causing their sleep issues. Either during or after the first 8\-10 weeks we'll start to delve into the underlying psychological factors (such as anxiety, stress, depression) and then continue to help our clients manage those underlying factors over the long run.   Looking forward to possibly working together and making a difference!   Job Types: Full\-time, Part\-time, Contract, Temporary   Pay: $85\.00 \- $110\.00 per hour   Expected hours: No less than 15 per week   Benefits:   * 401(k) * Dental insurance * Flexible schedule * Health insurance * Paid time off * Professional development assistance * Vision insurance   Schedule:   * Choose your own hours * Evening shift * Monday to Friday * Weekends as needed   Application Question(s):   * Do you have experience counseling 1:1 with adult clients? * When would you be available to start? * What’s your general weekly availability (in hours)? * How long do you see yourself being able to commit to this role? * Do you anticipate any changes to your availability over the next 12 months? * What are your primary areas of focus or interest in mental health? * Can you provide your mental health license number and what states you are licensed in? * Which payers have you been credentialed with?   Experience:   * Private practice: 2 years (Preferred) * Telehealth: 2 years (Preferred) * Cognitive behavioral therapy: 2 years (Preferred) * Cognitive behavioral therapy for insomnia (CBTI): 1 year (Preferred)   Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Marketing Specialist
jobs.description:
**Overview**

TABS, Inc. provides assistance and guidance to foreign companies when starting or expanding their business in the U.S. TABS currently has offices in New York, Humble, TX, and The Netherlands. Due to our recent growth, we are seeking a **Marketing Specialist.** The Marketing Specialist is responsible for supporting the planning, execution, and optimization of the company’s marketing efforts. The market specialist manages the website, social media, conducts research, implements campaigns, analyzes data, and helps ensure consistent messaging and brand presence across all platforms, while also supporting the business development and client engagement efforts of the company.

 

**Responsibilities**

 

* **Market Research and Analysis:** Perform market research to understand target audiences, market trends, competitor strategies and customer needs.

* **Brand Management:** Review current brand guide and identify areas for improvement, ensure it is kept up to date and used accurately by all team members.

* **Content Creation and Social Media Management:** Create content, such as informational articles, team member spotlights, company updates, etc and share across all social media platforms.

* **Client Testimonials:** Collaborate with Team Leaders to gather client testimonials and incorporate positive feedback through website and social media posts.

* **Website Management \& SEO:** Optimize website content for search engines (SEO)

* **Reporting:** Create and distribute monthly reports on critical metrics for lead generation, content creation, website traffic, and other KPIs

* **Event Planning:** Assist in the planning and marketing of events hosted and/or attended by TABS Team Leaders and BizDev \& Relations Team, including content creation and engagement

* **Continuous Improvement:** Analyze existing marketing strategy with a critical eye and identify opportunities for improvement

* **Promotional Material:** Assist with creation of promotional materials such as brochures, flyers and advertisements.

* **Cross\-Team Collaboration:** Work closely with the Business Development, Client Relations, and service teams to align messaging and support company\-wide initiatives.

 

**TEAM:**

 

The Marketing Specialist will be part of the Business Development and Relations Team.

 

**Qualifications**

 

* Bachelor’s degree and 2\+ years of relevant work experience, or High School Diploma and 4\+ years of relevant work experience.

* Social media experience, including familiarity with LinkedIn.

* Experience with website management, including SEO’s

* Brand management experience

* Experience with market research

* Experience creating content, including blogs or newsletters

* Experience with analytics and reporting tools

* Experience with event management is preferred.

* Great organizational and administrative skills

* Great communication skills

* Ability to handle multiple deadlines and tasks

* Great analytical skills and creative

* Ability to recognize and adapt to evolving market trends

 

**Software and Data Security:**

 

The Marketing Specialist has access to a variety of software platforms, client information, and internal documents to carry out their day\-to\-day responsibilities. They are expected to understand the sensitive nature of the data they handle and take appropriate steps to safeguard it at all times. This includes adhering to company protocols for secure storage, transmission, and access of data, as well as demonstrating a working knowledge of key data protection laws. The employee must be familiar with the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and evolving data privacy laws in various U.S. states. The Marketing Specialist plays an active role in ensuring compliance with consent requirements, cookie policies, email marketing regulations, and overall best practices in data privacy.

 

The software used may include:

 

* Social media platforms \& management tools such as LinkedIn \& Buffer

* Digital Marketing \& Campaign Tools such as Active Campaign, Google Ads, Mailchimp

* Analytics, SEO \& Reporting tools such as Google Analytics

* CRM \& Sales Tools such as Insightly

* Design \& Content Creation software such as Adobe Creative Suite, Canva, WordPress, Foleon, etc.

 

**WORKING CONDITIONS:**

 

**Physical demands**

 

* The Marketing Specialist will spend long hours sitting and using the computer, which can cause muscle and eye strain.

 

**Work Environment**

 

* Professional office environment.

* An open area office with a low to moderate noise level.

* The job requires use of standard office equipment such as a computer, phone and print\-scan machine.

 

Job Type: Full\-time

 

Pay: $60,000\.00 \- $68,000\.00 per year

 

Benefits:

 

* 401(k)

* 401(k) matching

* Dental insurance

* Flexible schedule

* Flexible spending account

* Health insurance

* Health savings account

* Life insurance

* Paid time off

* Professional development assistance

* Tuition reimbursement

* Vision insurance

 

Application Question(s):

 

* This position offers a salary range of $60,000\-68,000, depending on experience. Are you comfortable with this range?

* Have you held a role where your primary responsibility was marketing (not sales, admin, or a mix of functions)?

* What marketing tools have you used professionally (example: HubSpot, Mailchimp, WordPress, Adobe Creative Suite, Canva, etc)?

* Do you have experience working on marketing campaigns for international audiences or global markets?

 

Experience:

 

* marketing: 2 years (Preferred)

 

Ability to Commute:

 

* New York, NY 10017 (Preferred)

 

Work Location: Hybrid remote in New York, NY 10017

You’ll set the culture, control the client experience, and drive team revenue—without having to start from scratch.

 

**Your Responsibilities**

* Serve as the team’s top listing and buyer agent

* Recruit, onboard, and train new agents and ISAs

**Drive Vision \& Growth**

 

* Build and own the strategic plan for team growth (headcount \& revenue)

* Work closely with the Operations Manager to scale efficiently

**You Are a Fit If You:**

 

✅ Are a licensed agent in **Maryland, with DC and/or VA** licenses preferred

✅ Have closed **10\+ transactions per year** consistently

✅ Are known for your leadership, drive, and follow\-through

✅ Are passionate about coaching others and building careers

✅ Think like a business owner and move like a top salesperson

✅ Understand sales funnels, leverage, and systems

**What We Offer:**

**Now Hiring: Real Estate Listing Specialist**

**Location:** Montgomery County, Maryland

**Company:** Keller Williams Capital Properties

**Employment Type:** Full\-Time

**Compensation:** Commission\-Based (OTE $100K–$175K\+)

**Start Date:** Immediate

 

**About Keller Williams Capital Properties**

 

At **Keller Williams Capital Properties (KWCP)**, we’re redefining what success looks like in real estate. As one of the most recognized and agent\-centric brokerages in the region, we invest in people, systems, and innovation to help our agents thrive. We're currently seeking a motivated and strategic **Listing Specialist** to help us serve more sellers, deliver world\-class results, and grow market share across Montgomery County.

 

**Position Summary: Real Estate Listing Specialist**

 

The **Listing Specialist** plays a vital role in helping homeowners sell their properties with confidence. You’ll be responsible for client acquisition, listing presentations, pricing strategy, marketing coordination, and negotiations. You’ll also work closely with our support staff and leadership team to deliver an exceptional experience from the initial consultation through closing.

 

This is a high\-impact role for someone who loves the listing side, is energized by client interaction, and knows how to win in competitive markets.

 

**Core Responsibilities**

 

**Client Consultation**

 

* Conduct in\-person or virtual listing consultations

* Provide market analysis and pricing strategies backed by comps and data

* Present and sign listing agreements using proven scripts and listing systems

* Advise sellers on home preparation, staging, and timelines

 

**Marketing \& Listing Management**

 

* Coordinate photography, videography, virtual tours, and marketing materials

* Ensure listings are entered into MLS and syndicated platforms promptly and accurately

* Collaborate with marketing team on custom campaigns, open houses, and promotions

* Respond to buyer and agent inquiries and schedule showings as needed

 

**Offer \& Contract Negotiation**

 

* Present and review offers with sellers, provide strategic advice

* Negotiate terms, contingencies, and closing timelines

* Work with admin team and transaction coordinator to manage deadlines and paperwork

* Attend inspections, appraisals, and closings when needed

 

**Qualifications**

 

**Required:**

 

* Active **Maryland, DC, and/or Virginia real estate license**

* Minimum 2\+ years of real estate sales experience, with a strong preference for listing background

* Proven ability to win listing appointments and close deals

* Excellent communication and presentation skills

* Strong knowledge of pricing strategy, listing preparation, and seller timelines

* Reliable transportation and flexible availability

* Tech\-savvy with experience in MLS, DocuSign, CRM tools, and digital marketing

 

**Preferred:**

 

* Listing\-specific training or designations (e.g., CLHMS, SRS, PSA)

* Keller Williams systems experience (Command, Listing Toolkit, SmartPlans)

* Experience working with high\-volume teams or top producer groups

* Familiarity with Montgomery County and surrounding submarkets

 

**What We Provide**

 

* Professional media, signage, lockboxes, and listing resources

* Robust CRM, marketing tools, and tech stack to stay organized and ahead

* Daily team huddles, weekly coaching, and monthly mastermind sessions

* Access to \#1\-ranked training company in real estate (Keller Williams University)

* A collaborative, energetic culture focused on growth and results

* Full transaction coordination and administrative support

 

**You’re a Great Fit If You Are:**

 

✅ Naturally confident and persuasive in consultations

✅ Highly organized and deadline\-driven

✅ Calm under pressure and skilled at managing client emotions

✅ Passionate about helping sellers succeed

✅ Committed to continuous improvement and growth

 

**If you're ready to dominate the listing side with a top\-tier brand and proven systems, this is your opportunity.**

Apply now and grow your career as a **Listing Specialist** at **Keller Williams Capital Properties – Montgomery County**

 

Job Types: Full\-time, Part\-time, Contract

 

Pay: $100,000\.00 \- $175,000\.00 per year

 

Benefits:

 

* Flexible schedule

 

Schedule:

 

* Choose your own hours

 

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Bethesda, MD 20814

jobs.title: Outreach & Account Coordinator – School & Library Book Donation Bins
jobs.description:
**About Us:**

Clean Earth Books is dedicated to giving used books a second life. We work to keep books out of landfills and into the hands of readers by partnering with communities, schools, and libraries to collect gently used books through convenient donation bins.

 

**The Role:**

We are seeking a passionate and persuasive **Outreach \& Account Coordinator** to help us expand and manage our book donation bin program. Your mission: connect with schools and libraries to place donation bins on their property—and maintain strong, ongoing relationships with those partners to ensure program success.

 

**Ideal Candidate:**

 

* Experience working in or with schools or libraries (former librarian, school admin, media specialist, etc.)

* Strong understanding of how institutions handle excess or unwanted books

* Excellent communication and relationship\-building skills

* Comfortable with phone and email outreach

* Highly organized with experience in basic account or partner management

* Self\-motivated and professional

 

**Responsibilities:**

 

* Identify and reach out to schools and libraries across targeted regions

* Explain the benefits of our donation bin program and secure placement opportunities

* Serve as the primary point of contact for partner sites

* Coordinate logistics for new and existing bin locations

* Monitor and support partner satisfaction, responding to questions or concerns

* Maintain accurate records of outreach, placements, and ongoing communications

 

**Why Join Us?**

 

* Be part of an environmentally conscious mission

* Flexible schedule and remote\-friendly

* Build lasting partnerships that keep books in circulation and out of landfills

 

Job Type: Full\-time

 

Pay: $42,000\.00 \- $48,000\.00 per year

 

Benefits:

 

* Paid time off

 

Schedule:

 

* Day shift

 

Application Question(s):

 

* Why do you think you would be a good fit for this role?

* What relevant experience do you have that would assist in succeeding in this role?

 

Ability to Commute:

 

* Atlanta, GA 30336 (Required)

 

Ability to Relocate:

 

* Atlanta, GA 30336: Relocate before starting work (Required)

 

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Atlanta, GA 30336

jobs.title: Client Experience & Sales Support Coordinator – Kansas City (In-Office)
jobs.description:
**Why Towner**

 

We’re a people\-first technology company that believes work should be meaningful, fast\-moving, and not soul\-sucking. Our team genuinely likes each other. We invest in our people. And when we say “culture,” we mean it—and live it.

 

**The Role**

 

Looking for a job where your follow\-through, warmth, and attention to detail actually matter?

 

Towner Communications is hiring a full\-time **Client Experience \& Sales Support Coordinator** in our Kansas City office.

 

This isn’t a background admin job—it’s the heartbeat of our client communication and sales coordination. You’ll be the first face our clients know, the calm in the chaos, and the organizational power behind our sales team’s momentum.

 

**What You’ll Do**

 

Be the friendly first point of contact for prospective and current clients via phone, email, and web

 

Schedule meetings, demos, and internal events for the sales team

 

Keep CRM (ConnectWise) records accurate and up to date

 

Prep and send templated materials (decks, quotes, follow\-ups)

 

Coordinate internal meetings, small celebrations, and new hire onboarding

 

Monitor client satisfaction and follow up with care and precision

 

Keep the energy high and the cracks sealed across the office

 

**Who You Are**

 

5\+ years in admin, client services, or sales support

 

Exceptional communication and follow\-up instincts

 

Highly organized, calm under pressure, and detail\-obsessed

 

Tech\-comfortable (Outlook, Excel, Teams, CRMs/ConnectWise)

 

Confident, kind, and not afraid to take initiative

 

Based in Kansas City and able to work in\-office Monday through Friday

 

**Perks \& Culture**

 

$55K\+ salary

 

Health coverage (Cigna; $200/month employer contribution)

 

SIMPLE IRA with 3% match (after 90 days)

 

88 hours PTO annually (available after 90 days)

 

Team\-driven, no\-micromanaging culture

 

Real career growth, collaboration, and celebrations that actually mean something

 

**This role is 100% in\-office.**

Remote and hybrid applicants will not be considered.

\*

 

Job Type: Full\-time

 

Pay: $55,964\.00 \- $57,068\.00 per year

 

Benefits:

 

* 401(k)

* 401(k) matching

* Dental insurance

* Health insurance

* Paid time off

* Parental leave

* Professional development assistance

* Referral program

* Vision insurance

 

Shift:

 

* Day shift

 

Application Question(s):

 

* Are you currently located in the Kansas City area and able to work in our office Monday through Friday?

* Describe a time you juggled multiple competing priorities in a fast\-paced environment. What tools or systems did you use to stay organized?

* What CRM or scheduling tools have you used in past roles, and how comfortable are you managing follow\-ups and detailed records?

* What does “excellent client experience” mean to you, and how have you delivered that in a previous role?

* How would your former coworkers describe your communication style and your attention to detail?

* Tell us about a time something went wrong with a client. What happened, and how did you handle it?

 

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Application Support Engineer
jobs.description:
**Piper Companies** is seeking an **Application Support Engineer** to join an established **Healthcare organization** located in **Maryland**. This is a **remote** contract to possible hire opportunity. The **Application Support Engineer** will ensure the stability and functionality of systems supporting the Health Information Exchange Portal and APIs, serving as a tier\-2 support resource and coordinating system access, integration, and operational improvements.

 

**Requirements for the Application Support Engineer:**

 

* Analyze logs and data to identify patterns, proactively detect trends, and resolve issues efficiently.

* Perform daily operational tasks to ensure system health, while maintaining compliance with privacy and security policies.

* Troubleshoot API and connectivity issues in collaboration with customers, internal teams, and vendors.

* Respond to escalated support requests from tier\-1, and assist in extending services for existing customers.

* Refine technical processes for efficiency and mentor junior staff as needed

 

**Qualifications for the Application Support Engineer:**

 

* Demonstrated understanding of computer science principles, programming, and system ownership, including API and interface support.

* Strong problem\-solving skills with the ability to evaluate and resolve complex technical issues independently.

* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to convey technical information to both technical and non\-technical audiences.

* Proven ability to create, interpret, and refine technical documentation and processes to drive efficiency and system reliability.

* Experience with healthcare IT and integrations, including SSO standards such as OIDC and SAML 2\.0\.

* Proficiency in Microsoft Azure (including monitoring tools), Salesforce (Salesforce Administrator Credential preferred), Databricks, and Azure Data Factory.

* Intermediate to advanced fluency in KQL, Python, SQL, and SOQL, with experience crafting complex queries and troubleshooting APIs.

* Familiarity with networking principles and strong working knowledge of Microsoft Office, especially Excel.

 

**Compensation for the Application Support Engineer:**

 

* **Target Salary Upon Conversion:** $75,000\-$95,000 *\*\*\*depending on experience\*\*\**

* **Comprehensive Benefits:** Medical, Dental, Vision, 401K, PTO, Sick Leave if required by law
